Friend,
Outside a high school in Breese, Illinois, an area that national Democrats have long abandoned, the Proud Boys put up a massive billboard recruiting young people into their racist, extremist gang:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
We saw it. We refused to let it slide. And Resist Reclaim Rebuild acted.
Our team came together, pooled resources, and put up a billboard of our own — one that called out the Proud Boys for exactly what they are: violent, hate-filled extremists:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
And guess what? The Proud Boys’ billboard is now GONE! Taken down. Removed.
But you and I both know this fight doesn’t end in Breese. Extremist groups are recruiting across the country. If we don’t push back, they grow bolder.
Resist Reclaim Rebuild is ready to keep going — to meet hate head-on wherever it shows its face. But we can only do that if our movement has the resources to keep fighting. Can we count on you to chip in $100, $20, or even just $15 today to help us keep fighting back against MAGA Extremism? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
DONATE TODAY TO HELP DEFEAT MAGA EXTREMISM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrrsms-bb?refcode=250930_rrr_billboard]
Every dollar you give helps us push back against extremism, call it out publicly, and make sure young people see that there is another way forward.
We can’t let hate win. Together, we won’t.
In strength,
The Resist Reclaim Rebuild Team

subject: LEAKED Poll: Haaland is up 6. But, here's the catch....
body:
Plus: NM ranks 4th in taxes — 50th in income | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oCE6r6RL5Bd?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
A poll just leaked. [It's the first real look at the New Mexico Governor's race since the primary](https://us.list-manage.com/kduCvxJDU09?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e) — and the numbers behind the headline tell a story the press isn't going to tell you.
Deb Haaland leads Gregg Hull. That's the topline. Underneath it, there's a clean hit Hull has on her that nobody is talking about.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TcwJWh9MtSl?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **LEAKED POLL — HAALAND UP 6, BUT THE CRACKS ARE REAL**
The poll went into the field June 9-11 from one of the best firms in the country, and we got a look at every question and every answer in it.
The topline shows Haaland up 6, but the breakdown is where it gets interesting. She's running a 14-point net gender gap with men, and 72% of voters say Haaland is liberal even though only 32% of them describe themselves that way.
The fracking ban is where Hull has his cleanest shot. Even with soft polling language, 44% of voters said it would make them less likely to support her. The real question now is whether Hull is willing to actually throw the punch.

🚨 **$113 MILLION TAX HIKE — THE ONE COUNCIL JUST KILLED IS BACK**
City Council voted 8-1 to reject this in March. Albuquerque Councilor Brook Bassan brought it back anyway — and this time, it's headed to the November ballot.
Half a penny on every dollar. $113 million a year. Funding a project that another councilor — Tammy Fiebelkorn — called a "vanity project."
We pulled the spending data. Albuquerque city spending is up 68% in 10 years.
---
| [Stream No Doubt About It Podcast Now](https://us.list-manage.com/jPFZImdeikK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
💰 **NM RANKS 4TH IN TAXES — AND 50TH IN INCOME**
That's not a typo. We rank fourth in the country for total tax burden. We rank dead last for median household income — $25,000 below the U.S. average.
And the city wants to raise the tax again. We do the math.

😂 **ELON MUSK BECOMES FIRST TRILLIONAIRE — CNN IMPLODES**
The SpaceX IPO Friday was the largest in history. $75 billion raised. Musk briefly worth more than $1 trillion on paper. 4,400 SpaceX employees became millionaires overnight.
Bakari Sellers went on CNN and said no one should be "allowed" to have that much money. Scott Jennings's response is one of his best of the year.

body:

| | | | | |
# **Join Forces with Jonny**
---
| | Hi Friend,

Trump has launch a bid for his latest pet project. Now that his name – illegally placed on the Kennedy Arts Center – has been removed, he is trying yet another angle to plaster his infamous legacy in Washington. The “Triumphal Arch” proposed to be placed within the George Washington Memorial Parkway in Washington, D.C. I feel I stand with the many when I say this is a massive waste of taxpayer money, and clearly not addressing the affordability crisis nationwide. You can do something! Submit your comment in opposition for this joke of a project [here](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=fad5989cc1&e=c29ddb867a). There is strength in numbers.
We’ve met so many of you on the campaign trail, and couldn’t continue without taking a moment to thank you for your help! Truly, nothing happens without you!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |
Our friend, [Becky Moss](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=66e86d8d13&e=c29ddb867a), is a long-time advocate for LGBTQ+ rights here in Utah, and as a foster parent also my second mom! We’re so grateful to have her support.

---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
We are happy to have the endorsement of the Utah [Women’s Democratic Club of Utah](https://jonnyutah4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc76e2ed74de192812d6308cf&id=8caf65d085&e=c29ddb867a). This amazing organization of women work hard to get democrats across the state elected. Thank you for the support!
---
| |
---
| |
We are also pleased to have endorsements from the Utah Labor Caucus, Utah Stonewall Democrats, Center for FreeThought Equality, Utah Veterans’ Caucus, Salt Lake County Progressives Caucus, Young Democrats of Utah, and AANHPI Democratic Caucus.
We are thankful for all the support we receive, and truly the more donations we receive, the more we can get out and meet you! We’d love you to join our coalition of volunteers, or consider donating to the campaign!
Yours in solidarity.

Semper Fi,

Jonny

---
|
---
| |

U.S. Rep. Adriano Espaillat (D-NY) walks through the U.S. Capitol on February 10, 2026 in Washington, DC. Photo by Heather Diehl/Getty Images.
A surge of last-minute support from major pro-Israel donors, including AIPAC's former president Bob Cohen, has flooded into the campaign of Rep. Adriano Espaillat, who faces a formidable primary challenge from local community organizer Darializa Avila Chevalier in New York's 13th congressional district.
On a single day, June 4, 2026, Espaillat raised just under $112,000 from 69 wealthy donors at an average of $1,623 per contribution. Not a single donor listed an address inside Espaillat's district, which encompasses Harlem and surrounding areas, and 48 of the donors have also given large amounts of money to the American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) since 2023. That number goes up to 67 out of the 69 contributors if you include donations to AIPAC-adjacent organizations like Democratic Majority for Israel and the Republican Jewish Coalition. At least 44 of the new Espaillat donors have given heavily to Republicans.
The pro-Israel money comes amid a multimillion-dollar push to rescue Espaillat, chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, in the waning days of a campaign that ends on June 23. Espaillat and the New York Post have teamed up over the past week to hammer Avila Chevalier, who has the support of the local Democratic Socialists of America chapter as well as Justice Democrats, for a series of unapologetically leftist tweets, as well as for her attendance at a rally on October 8, 2023, for a ceasefire in Gaza, which her critics say came too early.
As AIPAC's money has grown increasingly toxic, the organization has relied heavily on funneling money through shell PACs or directing donors straight to a candidate. When reporters then identify the link between the donors and the candidate, AIPAC cries foul, saying it's unfair to single them out. If the numbers at play were small, or the contributions themselves were not from major AIPAC donors, they might have a point. But the calvary coming to rescue Espaillat is not a collection of modest AIPAC donors--it's major funders of the organization. Cohen, a national AIPAC board member, has raised tens of millions for the group and led the push against President Obama's Iran nuclear deal. His real estate firm, R.A. Cohen & Associates, often clashes in New York City with local activists. Six of the donors have given $428,000 to AIPAC's super PAC, the United Democracy Project. Since 2023, the few dozen donors have given nearly a million dollars directly to AIPAC and another half million to GOP candidates.
The financing helps explain why Espaillat continues to take politically toxic positions in his campaign even as he faces an ignominious defeat at the hands of a previously unknown activist.
At a recent debate, Espaillat once again refused to describe Israel's assault on Gaza as a genocide, instead describing it vaguely as a "horrific situation," and avoided acknowledging Israel as the culprit, saying, "whoever perpetrated that action should be held to the highest standard of accountability." The congressman [dodged debate questions](https://substack.com/redirect/b0cb7b4a-913b-4f80-8173-06a696538dc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about pro-Israel Super PAC spending on his behalf and the more than $676,000 in direct contributions he has accepted from AIPAC, saying, "my values are those of the people that I represent. They tell me how to vote."
Espalliat has [taken contributions directly from AIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/a53b65ef-8302-4653-8ced-8ca2b4db2c9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as recently as March 18, and has joined congressional delegations to Israel on the lobby's dime. Through Democracy Engine--a payment processor used by AIPAC that allows donors to route money directly to multiple candidates at once--his campaign has received an additional $376,398.
Since early May, Espaillat has benefitted from [more than $3.3 million in outside spending](https://substack.com/redirect/a510dfc9-7d7f-4425-a7e9-92c0b39121e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from three super PACs that brand themselves as advocates for issues facing the Latino community.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.xTnrqdU758KDoRKUp1Tcz6nMVS5emn7gp5NDkK5e5xM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=202205431)
BOLD America, responsible for more than $2.5 million of these three groups' outside spending for Espalliat over the last month, appeared effectively destitute by Super PAC standards in its last FEC filing before the spending push, [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/e1055496-4cca-4db7-b88d-3244e6c03f62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) less than $250,000 total cash-on-hand. Of the fundraising it _has_ declared, [$50,000 of it was raised](https://substack.com/redirect/5682b3ce-579b-4510-aebd-f7d31b0050b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Coinbase, the largest American cryptocurrency company, and $150,000 from International Bancshares Corporation, the largest minority-owned bank in the country.
The name BOLD America appears to be an effort to sound like BOLD PAC, the primary vehicle used by the Congressional Hispanic Caucus since Espaillat was elected chair in November 2024.
That leaves $2.25 million in secret money backing Espaillat, which won't be disclosed until after the election. The dozens of pro-Israel donors listed on his June 4 disclosure, however, certainly have the capacity to have funded the Super PAC as well.
Groups backing Avila Chevalier have decried the covert spending maneuvers used to skirt disclosure requirements.
"The fact that Super PACs spending over $4 million attacking Darializa will not have to disclose their donors until after this election is exactly the kind of political corruption that voters are so fed up with from AIPAC stooges like Adriano Espaillat," said Usamah Andrabi, communications director for Justice Democrats. "If you're going to let them bankroll your campaign, at least own up to it."
On May 8, Latino Victory Fund spent $475,000 on ads supporting Espaillat. Ten days later, on May 18, BOLD America spent another $600,000 on pro-Espaillat advertising. Four days later, on May 22, Latino Victory Fund poured an additional $50,000 into the race, $46,500 backing Espaillat and $3,500 attacking his opponent Avila Chevalier.
The Congressional Hispanic Caucus's BOLD PAC has [taken money directly from AIPAC](https://substack.com/redirect/136882d1-3bb6-40bd-ab3c-5ea04da62223?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this cycle, then dumped roughly $230,000 behind Espaillat on June 1, followed by more than $730,000 from BOLD America over the next two days. On June 9 and 10, BOLD America reported [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/cda6a66d-e7d1-4164-be70-f4ab9f93364a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) yet another $1.2 million primarily on attack ads against Avila Chevalier, as the progressive insurgent was climbing in the polls.
Latino Victory Fund, by comparison, [had](https://substack.com/redirect/ccdb5687-b650-4ae7-8d7e-be8c8de2539e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) $912,725 cash-on-hand. CHC Bold PAC, the official spending arm of the caucus, was even more [flush with cash](https://substack.com/redirect/835c148f-40a0-4350-af56-fcaf5b187f5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at $3,297,278, but spent less than $230,000 of the total $3.3 million dump.
For Super PACs that file quarterly reports, the last one on record only covers money raised through March 31, 2026. The next quarterly report isn't due until after the June 23 primary, meaning much of the money can be concealed until after votes are cast.
This massive dark money spending push comes as Avila Chevalier has secured key endorsements from NYC DSA and Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who [promised](https://substack.com/redirect/4fbd9b46-bd25-4ac2-9e18-6345233decba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to back Espaillat for reelection last summer, according to Rep. Nydia Velasquez.
Avila Chevalier has benefited from the backing of super PAC [spending](https://substack.com/redirect/c12a64fc-2e7f-4c79-8174-d36ecca3db8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Justice Democrats and American Priorities to the tune of about $1.3 million total. American Priorities is a new super PAC organized to challenge candidates backed by AIPAC; Justice Democrats, which recruited Avila Chevalier, backs left-wing Democrats.
The race between Avila Chevalier and Espaillat reflects an ideological battle for control of the post-Trump Democratic Party. Espaillat represents an establishment wing of the party with close ties to institutional power players, even though he himself previously challenged the incumbent in the seat at the time, Charlie Rangel. For her part, Avila Chevalier--now being dubbed DAC-- has embraced more combative positions throughout her campaign, [running significantly to the left of AOC](https://substack.com/redirect/7ad537e9-1806-4240-8616-fb85b86fa3db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"We need to stop sending our tax dollars to a state that is currently enacting a genocide, a word that my opponent has yet to say," Avila Chevalier said during the June 12 debate. "There cannot be peace when the American taxpayer dollar is continuing to be used to slaughter civilians."

Nydia Velasquez. Avila Chevalier has benefited from the backing of super PAC from Justice Democrats and American Priorities to the tune of about $1.3 million total. American Priorities is a new super PAC organized to challenge candidates backed by AIPAC; Justice Democrats, which recruited Avila Chevalier, backs left-wing Democrats. The race between Avila Chevalier and Espaillat reflects an ideological battle for control of the post-Trump Democratic Party. Espaillat represents an establishment wing of the party with close ties to institutional power players, even though he himself previously challenged the incumbent in the seat at the time, Charlie Rangel. For her part, Avila Chevalier--now being dubbed DAC-- has embraced more combative positions throughout her campaign, . "We need to stop sending our tax dollars to a state that is currently enacting a genocide, a word that my opponent has yet to say," Avila Chevalier said during the June 12 debate. name: Elijah Norton for Arizona Treasurer
subject: To manage $32 billion of your dollars, we need experience!
body:
The Treasurer's job is often overlooked, but it is extremely important.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/BRTfmM9s7dr?e=4bbfddebd7&c2id=3a28d4e25e67509d3bf28128bdefbc4b)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Hello Peter,
My name is Elijah Norton, and I am running to be your next state Treasurer.
The Treasurer's job is often overlooked, but it is extremely important. For example, did you know the state budget and your tax burden are directly related to the success the Treasurer has in state investment performance?
The State Treasurer manages over $32 **billion** of your money and determines how your money is invested. This is why it is imperative that we elect someone with investment and finance experience to this role.
I have lived the American dream - at 21 years old I started a business with just a dream and $1,000. Today, it generates nearly half a billion dollars in annual revenue, operates across the United States and around the globe, and employs nearly 400 people. As the owner of a global insurance organization, I directly manage and oversee the investment of over $100 million of claims reserves. I must invest those reserves according to NAIC investment guidelines, which are more conservative than the guidelines the State Treasurer has to follow. **I want to apply this experience to safely achieve the best returns for you,** **prioritizing safety over liquidity and liquidity over yield.**
In addition to putting my experience to work for you, I want to work with our legislature to **conduct a DOGE-style audit of our entire public education system and state budget to expose the waste, fraud, and abuse rampant in our public education system.** I did this when I served as the Treasurer of the Arizona Republican Party - where I was trusted to manage over $20 million in donations ($10 million of which was spent directly on electing President Donald J. Trump). As AZGOP Treasurer, we had one of the most successful election years in recent history - with President Trump having the biggest victory of any swing state, we added seats to our legislative majorities, and kept both of our swing congressional seats in Republican hands.
My work as the AZGOP Treasurer stabilized and strengthened the Party. Gov. Katie Hobbs has decimated Arizona’s finances. I’m the only candidate for state Treasurer with the experience to stabilize the state finances and make Arizona strong again.
This office requires someone you can trust - with proven investment and finance experience. We also need someone who can beat the Democrat in November. There hasn't been a Democrat Treasurer since 1967 - and for the first time the Democrats have nominated someone who can win. He has already raised **over a million dollars.** He has investment experience (albeit, bad experience) and would be absolutely terrible for our state.
I was the first person to enter this race on either side, and I am working around the clock to win this race and bring my business and finance experience to work for you, the taxpayers of Arizona, but I need your help!
But I can’t do it alone. I need your help. [**Please consider signing up to be a volunteer for our campaign.**](https://us.list-manage.com/189sSJ8QGug?e=4bbfddebd7&c2id=3a28d4e25e67509d3bf28128bdefbc4b) We have opportunities you can help with, either from the comfort of your home or in your neighborhood. Grab a yard sign, tell your friends and neighbors, and help us reach your friends, family, and neighbors, or phone bank!
Arizona cannot afford to have someone with no background in finance or investments managing $32 billion of your dollars - **or worse** \- a far-left radical Democrat like Nick Mansour.
Thank you for your consideration and support!
Elijah Norton

If you would like to get fewer emails, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59469?t=1&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) If you would like to unsubscribe, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59470?t=2&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) [](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=3&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) Team, this is Mary Trump.

You may know me as the author of _Too Much and Never Enough,_ or as someone who has spent years sounding the alarm about my uncle, Donald.

[**Yesterday, I launched Transcend PAC to fund the candidates fighting Donald's corruption every day, who will strengthen the democracy my uncle is trying to destroy. If you can give, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and Fight For Reform, and then read on to learn why I believe this moment calls for something transformational.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=4&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) | [BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TODAY >>](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=5&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)
---
* * *
[**Here's what I need you to understand about my uncle: Donald is a weak man.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=6&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

That might seem like an odd thing to say about somebody who holds such a powerful position, but that's exactly the danger. Every day, as Donald deteriorates – psychologically, emotionally, and cognitively – he grows more desperate, increasing the risk to the rest of us.

Strong people do not rig the system in their favor. They don't silence critics. They don't seek to control the institutions designed to hold them accountable. [**Donald does all of those things — because he has to, and he knows it. His behavior isn't evidence of strength – it's evidence of its absence.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=7&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

The comprehensiveness with which Donald and the complicit Republican party are attempting to dismantle our institutions and take away our rights, in service to maintaining their hold on power and self-enrichment, should also make clear what is at stake.

Under Donald’s so-called leadership, the Republicans in Congress have stood by while our nation’s alliances have become strained; illegal wars have been started; and our institutions have been weakened and, in some cases, dismantled entirely.

I believe we are going to prevail. But when corrupt leaders like Donald and the sycophantic enablers in his inner circle go unchecked or unchallenged, they can do enormous damage. The antidote is to assemble a coalition of people who refuse to look away and are willing to take action.

[**That’s why I’ve launched Transcend PAC. Together, we’ll fund candidates who believe in public service and who will work to fulfill the promise of American democracy.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=8&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w) Because we deserve representatives who understand what’s at stake and are prepared to meet the moment.

[**If you're able, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and Fight For Reform today. Your contribution funds the organizing and the advocacy that will ensure no voice is silenced and all of our voices are heard. Every dollar will go toward undoing the damage my uncle and the Republican Party have done so we, together, can build something better.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/74810?t=9&akid=24374%2E4449941%2E5SkK9w)

An unexpected setback.
| **Congress Proposes Zero Funding for Public Broadcasters' Educational Programming** Despite a judge's DEMAND to resume funding for public broadcasters, Congress STILL hasn’t acted and public media is STILL underwater.

**If we don’t act FAST, we could lose these critical networks for good!**

[**Public broadcasters need to know we have their backs! So we’re gathering 10,000 signatures by MIDNIGHT to stay in the fight and show our solidarity »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/112842?t=6&akid=25257%2E878179%2Ek4QaB6) | [**Chip in $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/112842?t=7&akid=25257%2E878179%2Ek4QaB6)

TO: Public Broadcasters
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! To all public broadcasters,

Thank you. Thank you for enriching all of our lives — in rural and urban areas, and everywhere in between — with your various news and educational programs.

I couldn’t be more THRILLED to see Trump’s disgusting executive order blocked. _His authoritarian power grab didn’t stand a chance against our fight._

**But until your funding is resumed, I won’t stop fighting. I also know that his attempts to SILENCE the free press won’t end here.**

It’s not just upsetting, _it’s a dangerous step towards an**outright dictatorship!**_ That’s why I’m not getting complacent.

[**I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $3 to VPP to thank you for your years of service and to join VPP in the fight against Trump’s attacks on the free press. name: Stacy Garrity
subject: Welcome to the team!
body:
Thanks for joining our campaign for a stronger Pennsylvania.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Peter,

Thank you for signing up and joining our campaign for Governor.
Over the past several years, I have had the privilege of serving as Pennsylvania's State Treasurer. During that time, I've traveled to all 67 counties every year because I believe public service starts with listening to the people you represent.
What I've heard is clear.
Pennsylvania families are struggling with rising costs. Too many young people are leaving our Commonwealth in search of opportunity elsewhere. Businesses face unnecessary obstacles, energy costs continue to rise, and too many people feel like state government is working for politicians instead of hardworking taxpayers.That's why I'm running for Governor.
I spent 30 years serving our nation in uniform, retiring as a Colonel in the Army Reserve. I also spent 30 years building a career in manufacturing. I've spent my life solving problems, leading teams, and getting results.
As Treasurer, we've returned more than $1 billion in unclaimed property, protected taxpayer dollars, strengthened Pennsylvania's finances, and modernized state government. Now, I'm ready to bring that same record of service and leadership to the Governor's Office.

But I can't do it alone.
This campaign is going to be powered by Pennsylvanians from every corner of our Commonwealth who are willing to stand up and fight for a better future.If you're ready to help, there are two important ways to get involved today:

Together, we can build a stronger, safer, and more prosperous Pennsylvania.

Hey folks,
When we were kids, we learned about the Scientific Method. My teacher had a big poster with all of the steps:
💡 Find a question to investigate.
📝 Make predictions.
🔬 Gather data.
📊 Analyze the data.
🤔 Draw conclusions.
It’s the exact approach I applied in medical school and in diagnosing and caring for patients in the intensive care unit. It’s the same way I lead, now, in Congress.
When I was a kid, my grandmother lived with us, and she had diabetes. I learned to dress her wounds and wondered, why don’t we all have the same access to medical help?
At first, I assumed there had to be a simple explanation. But as I moved through medical school and treated patients, I gathered the evidence.
I saw insurance companies deny care. I saw drug companies jack up prices. I saw families take on debt, work extra jobs, and postpone treatment just to stay afloat. Now, the MAGA movement is cutting programs like Medicaid and SNAP, and it’s just getting worse.
The data is clear.
And the conclusion is simple: healthcare is a human right, and every single American deserves affordable, high-quality healthcare.

| Friend,
Donald Trump to Truth Social to push Congress to pass the "Save America" Act--the most heinous voting restrictions in the history of the country.
It has already failed to pass in the Senate, with some vulnerable MAGA Senators worried the bill would be so extreme that the backlash would cause them to lose their seats to Democrats.
But Trump has a new absolutely terrifying sales pitch--it's actually the military that wants to restrict your right to vote:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O7kYSv9tFXbuTUSZjhm9iUknmyI9DU8IX7bs9H8kIFfSw7jJvsk8nFU2ljw9esc-5P0Wga_K_VyaW6DUw3KBBMb0LI-5y-AZ8KHFheFGs3AugfeXmKPR1EwfLafvWlGyfKMUk5cjNgu6kpbMg7yS7G0mAi-8weO-jr7TxWbrdDrSbsD8bsMqoLEdb0D0qgPvVwaS03dlZgU0MS-ZPZ6NJRvaw4asQXXeCtZk06rUYPeNhY5CCHOnoiEr0oKI-MuVZc_NBIkDTnI=&c=URCUnkuFDcP40y158LOvL17unNaGWhOCiNyBlO6NEJEbmgU1qoUSow==&ch=t2pk91qLj53LWc3qAzFX5vM13xglINnnIc_qGJDbP3YsqF1oadY3Sg==)
---
| Trump hasn't hidden his desire to have the military get involved in elections. Earlier this year, he refused to rule out deploying the National Guard to voting locations ahead of the midterms.
And how does the Pentagon's top brass feel about it? This was Pete Hegseth's response to Trump on social media:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O7kYSv9tFXbuTUSZjhm9iUknmyI9DU8IX7bs9H8kIFfSw7jJvsk8nFU2ljw9esc-5P0Wga_K_VyaW6DUw3KBBMb0LI-5y-AZ8KHFheFGs3AugfeXmKPR1EwfLafvWlGyfKMUk5cjNgu6kpbMg7yS7G0mAi-8weO-jr7TxWbrdDrSbsD8bsMqoLEdb0D0qgPvVwaS03dlZgU0MS-ZPZ6NJRvaw4asQXXeCtZk06rUYPeNhY5CCHOnopAu6coi5iICiCNGdUfcSj4=&c=URCUnkuFDcP40y158LOvL17unNaGWhOCiNyBlO6NEJEbmgU1qoUSow==&ch=t2pk91qLj53LWc3qAzFX5vM13xglINnnIc_qGJDbP3YsqF1oadY3Sg==)
---
| These are dark, serious, and unprecedented threats.
Since the founding of this nation, the military has separated itself from partisan politics. It's a key tenet of the separation of powers and there are multiple laws and military directives preventing personnel from being used for political purposes. But Trump and Hegseth not only seemed prepared but intending to cross that rubicon.
Trump's assault on free and fair elections escalates every single day. While we don't know what the full picture of his plans for November look like, the pieces are coming together and it's not pretty. The gears are motion and he has the sycophants and crooks by his side ready and willing to do anything and everything necessary to make sure MAGA wins.
We have to rapidly build a firewall to protect our democracy from Trump. That's why Defend Our Courts exists. We successfully defended the pro-democracy majority on the Pennsylvania and Wisconsin Supreme Court over the past year--safeguarding election integrity in critical swing states.
Now we're expanding the scope of our mission to meet the gravity of the threats our democracy faces at this moment: Building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections state by state. And leading the movement to reform the MAGA occupied U.S. Supreme Court that is enabling Trump's dismantling of our democracy.
[This is too important. We need you by our side come November: Can we count on you to rush a donation of $50, $25, or whatever you can spare to help us fight for free and fair elections?](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O7kYSv9tFXbuTUSZjhm9iUknmyI9DU8IX7bs9H8kIFfSw7jJvsk8nFU2ljw9esc-5P0Wga_K_VyaW6DUw3KBBMb0LI-5y-AZ8KHFheFGs3AugfeXmKPR1EwfLafvWlGyfKMUk5cjNgu6kpbMg7yS7G0mAi-8weO-jr7TxWbrdDrSbsD8bsMqoLEdb0D0qgPvVwaS03dlZgU0MS-ZPZ6NJRvaw4asQXXeCtZk06rUYPeNhY5CCHOnohnI8ceqVJ2Ru73RV31AM10=&c=URCUnkuFDcP40y158LOvL17unNaGWhOCiNyBlO6NEJEbmgU1qoUSow==&ch=t2pk91qLj53LWc3qAzFX5vM13xglINnnIc_qGJDbP3YsqF1oadY3Sg==)

## B-52 Bomber Crashes in California Desert
Eight crew members are believed to have died after a nuclear-capable[ B-52 Stratofortress crashed shortly after takeoff](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGupDAMRb8GOiPHJIFXUGwz3dt2S-Qk5pFVIKMQTTR_v2J-YSsXRzrS8f3zvX5zTPH8-c2HLHXL6yntSlKrlNUZ8oWvXS4-pETPV42HeH6uhGQBLSi7Bo7pveo-LJsIydjLoqZZWdQTzf2-4IiKFdJk0aJyjtDpebNGj7NBZOnjctvQKqtQEdrhS42a9fhlHRovm3QaJcSay_A3x7PusqV3fkkZfD76tOy1Pq9u_NXRo6NHa21ozO_6unFHj7vnPlxjPqHlkkJHjxl8kQaHHE7KBU5SlJcECMIB4gkMDgyByzeHzxeAK3hOccvljAwXSGhcwi3nUqNPso5-JkdmBHZqAsPawWzcBmRIUCyr0alhr0fqyxKeLaYULzt1Gn8OjunTU_9rhNdC_wIAAP__srqYzg) at Edwards Air Force Base in California's Mojave Desert on Monday.

The bomber was on a test mission that ended with a crash that sent a massive plume of black smoke into the sky above Kern County. An official release noted that "initial indications are that the crash was not survivable." subject: Thought you should hear this from me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Vivek Ramaswamy and Rob McColley for Ohio
body:
This is my home. I was born here. I built companies here. Apoorva and I are raising our three children here.

| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-Zev-3cbB56Ys18A)
---
Hi Peter, it’s Vivek.
You’ve probably heard by now: I’m running for Governor of Ohio. _But I want you to hear why — directly from me._
We’re living through a pivotal moment in American history.
President Trump’s decisive re-election was more than a political comeback — it was a national gut-check. A repudiation of the corrupt ruling class. A mandate to finally take back control of our country.
I was proud to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with President Trump on the frontlines: Turning out Gen Z voters for the GOP, rallying grassroots patriots, and building up the America First movement brick by brick.
---
| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._RPrYQ2rv5Jw)
---
| [](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
**[As President Trump leads at the federal level, the fight moves to the states — and I’m stepping up to lead it in Ohio.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-P9rPyIeSXVX1FH3M8uTQ)**
Because if we want to truly revive this country, we have to lead from the ground up — with bold, America First governors who won’t flinch in the face of the administrative state.
This is my home. I was born here. I built companies here. Apoorva and I are raising our three children here. And I believe Ohio can become the model for conservative excellence — a state that leads the nation with strength, vision, and unapologetic American pride.
---
[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._dX-D3bGtGP1dprA)
---
But that means doing things differently than they’ve always been done. I’m not running to manage the status quo. I’m running to disrupt it.
Here’s what that looks like:
1. **Tell folks the truth** – no lies, no gimmicks, no political speak
2. **Support Trump** – he will have no better partner at the state level
3. **Overhaul failing schools** – I’ll expand school choice and reward excellent teachers
4. **Restore national identity** – we’ll promote merit and patriotism, and reject victimhood
5. **Deport every illegal alien** – Tom Homan is a hero, he’ll have a direct line to my office
6. **Roll back transgenderism** – ban men in women’s sports, no sex changes for minors
7. **Slash taxes and lower prices** – you earned your nest egg, you should keep more of it
8. **Gut all DEI programs in the state** – we’ll be a model for rooting out woke propaganda
9. **Secure elections and prosecute fraud** – our elections will be the safest in the country
10. **Obliterate the managerial bureaucracy** – I’ll take a hacksaw to government bloat

I get it – that’s not everyone’s cup of tea. Some folks would rather settle for a liberal Democrat or a go-along-to-get-along Republican. That’s not me. And it’s not the campaign I’m running.
**[I’m in this because we need a fighter – someone with the spine to take on the Democrat machine and the Deep State – right here in battleground Ohio.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)**
And we can’t just win. We need to crush them.
**We need a landslide victory that sends a message across the nation – just like President Trump did in 2024.**
That’s where you come in:
_Whether you live in Ohio or not, will you make a contribution of ANY amount today? _
Not just to hit a goal, but to send a message: You’re with us. You believe in this movement. And you’re ready to fight.
---
**Choose your impact:**
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $4** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-NHtcrBrmXBw)
---
| [**CONTRIBUTE $40** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-lqfg)
---
| [**CONTRIBUTE $400** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
| [**GIVE ANOTHER AMOUNT** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._l4Yxw)
---
**[Every dollar you chip in helps me build the kind of grassroots army it will take to win the most important race in America in November.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)**
I’m not doing this for a political career. I’m doing this to get the job done — and leave this country stronger for the next generation.
Let’s make Ohio the leader of America’s revival.
Thank you — and God bless the United States of America.
**Vivek Ramaswamy**

Over 50% of Massachusetts Voters Can't Name a Healey Accomplishment
Boston MA - After three and a half years as Governor, most voters cannot name one Healey "Achievement" according to a new poll released by the Boston Globe.
The poll also found her policies do not align with voters, including:

* 56% of people considered moving due to high costs
* 69% are against Congestion Pricing (Drivers Tax)
* 65% support cutting state income tax rate from 5 percent to 4

The Boston Globe poll did not ask voters about the audit.
"We need a Governor who will focus on improving affordability, opportunity and safety to make people want to stay here for a lifetime, not taxing us until our children and grandchildren can't afford to live in the same state," said Amy Carnevale, Chairwoman of the Massachusetts Republican Party.
She continued, "Massachusetts cannot afford four more years of Maura Healey."

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.
**[I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t important.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260616_1.9ryrxs&amount=5&refcode=em20260616-1&t=1&akid=7213%2E582294%2EpOwWAK)**

Thank you.
Mark

# [The New Arsenal of Democracy](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=4399133&post_id=202270164&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAyMjcwMTY0LCJpYXQiOjE3ODE2MTIyMTAsImV4cCI6MTc4NDIwNDIxMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTQzOTkxMzMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.hA_VjERzlaistYn0_wZAR62lBUc2c96W28REYU4DjPo)
### America's military advantage depends as much on drones, AI, and industrial capacity as it once did on steel mills and shipyards.
| | [Patrick J. Murphy](https://substack.com/@patrickmurphypa)

| Jun 16

When FDR called America "the [great arsenal of democracy](https://substack.com/redirect/fe7762f3-1448-4c96-bbe5-b0364cde2bfb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in 1940 he wasn't waxing poetic about the greatness of America compared to the Axis powers. He was talking about our industrial capacity to outproduce our adversaries.
During World War II, Japan produced some of the most capable fighter aircraft in the world. The [Mitsubishi Zero](https://substack.com/redirect/1da1d883-5786-41ce-adca-4cd8832b2586?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was faster and more maneuverable than many of its American counterparts during the early stages of the war. But America possessed something even more powerful: industrial capacity. The United States built ships, aircraft, vehicles, and munitions at a pace no adversary could match. Ultimately, our higher production capacity proved decisive.
I think about that a lot when I look at where we are now.
When I deployed to Baghdad with the 82nd Airborne in 2003, the most advanced piece of personal technology I carried wasn't my M4 assault rifle, but the night vision goggles that allowed us to own the night. Higher headquarters had Abrams tanks, Apache helicopters, and precision-guided munitions that were the envy of every military on earth. What we didn't have was a drone that could find an IED before we drove over it, or an AI system processing battlefield data faster than any human intelligence officer could read it. Later, sitting on the House Armed Services Committee, I watched us fight the procurement bureaucracy just to get basic body armor and MRAPs fielded fast enough to keep soldiers alive. The battlefield I saw in Baghdad barely resembles the one being built today. Today's battlefields in Ukraine and Iran should be a warning about what happens if we don't keep up and adapt.

This Thursday I'll be speaking at the [Potomac Officers Club's Army Summit](https://substack.com/redirect/6c738fd0-f41c-4ef5-9c30-1b7fa7884a78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) alongside military leaders and defense innovators discussing how the Army is transforming for a new era. It's part of my continuing purpose to ensure America is fulfilling her most solemn duty -- to keep our families safe from those who want to do us harm.
The conversations in defense tech couldn't be more timely. Over the last four years, the world has received a real-time education in the future of warfare--from Russian tanks being taken down by [$600 drones in Ukraine](https://substack.com/redirect/105ecfb6-d7a3-4bd6-8298-c36be6e257cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to missile and drone barrages crossing the skies of the Middle East. Commercial technology is being adapted for military use in weeks rather than years. AI systems are helping process battlefield data and accelerate targeting decisions, while [autonomous systems](https://substack.com/redirect/79ded7ba-f4f0-45f5-a14a-fdc234b7177d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are transforming battlefields once dominated by tanks, ships, and aircraft. The battlefield is becoming faster, cheaper, and increasingly defined by software, sensors, and data. It's also reshaping America's strategic competition with China.
For decades, the United States enjoyed a significant technological advantage. We fielded capabilities that few countries could replicate, from stealth aircraft to precision-guided munitions. But just like the lesson learned in WWII, military competition is no longer just about who has the most advanced systems. It's also about who can produce, deploy, and scale them fastest.
The Department of Defense is pursuing the purchase of as many as [300,000 drones](https://substack.com/redirect/c529d5bf-909e-438d-8417-78e52a93e7bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as part of a broader effort to accelerate the deployment of autonomous systems and end reliance on Chinese-made components which currently dominates the world's market.
That number would have been almost unimaginable a decade ago. It reflects a growing recognition that future conflicts may be decided as much by production capacity and autonomous systems as by traditional military hardware.
But the strategic challenge extends beyond drones.
China has spent decades expanding its manufacturing base. According to the [U.S. Office of Naval Intelligence](https://substack.com/redirect/8cd69894-4756-4bd1-82f6-6e4941e973f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), China's shipbuilding capacity now exceeds America's by more than 200 to 1. They dominate key supply chains and have demonstrated an ability to scale production across entire industries with remarkable speed. In a prolonged conflict, commercial manufacturing capacity can quickly become military capacity, as America proved in World War II. China understands that the future of military competition requires speed and scale.
We're already seeing that dynamic play out in the drone market. Chinese drone manufacturers have gained [market share across the Middle East](https://substack.com/redirect/1305728b-e4ab-487c-b044-1dcdf400f754?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by offering systems that are cheaper, faster to acquire, and available with fewer restrictions than their Western counterparts.
That's why the Army's transformation efforts matter. The challenge isn't simply inventing the technologies of the future. It's getting them into the hands of soldiers faster--accelerating deployment, reducing acquisition timelines, integrating commercial innovation, and scaling the capabilities that will define modern warfare.
We're already seeing glimpses of what that future looks like. I toured [Angel Aerial Systems](https://substack.com/redirect/a163be22-7d71-46e2-8a0a-81f5ee8920ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a dual use drone company in Cincinnati co-founded by Navy veteran and former GE jet engine engineer Will Hasting, along with his co-founder Dennis Krause. I call Will the Tony Stark of Cincinnati. Angel Aerial recently competed against 200 companies in the Mojave Desert and has already advanced to the next round after outperforming 182 competitors. The system can fly for more than 100 minutes, zoom in on targets from three kilometers away, and is designed to be operated by regular soldiers with minimal training. Just as important, Angel Aerial is building six-pound drones using 3D printing and commercially available components, allowing them to be mass produced in hours rather than days.

Autonomous systems are becoming ubiquitous. Small drones that once took wedding photos are now being used to scout enemy positions, drop explosives, guide artillery fire, and deliver supplies to troops on the front lines.
It's not just about the drones themselves. It's also about how we defend against them. New directed-energy systems promise to reduce the cost of air defense dramatically.
Consider the economics of modern air defense. A drone assembled from commercially available components can cost a few thousand dollars. The missiles used to shoot Iranian drones have cost hundreds of thousands of dollars or more.
That is not a sustainable equation. The future belongs to systems that reverse that math.
One prime example is [Applied Energetics](https://substack.com/redirect/5c767b43-a478-442f-8ffb-75d3b28525bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an Arizona-based defense technology company led by another Navy Veteran that's developing ultrashort-pulse laser systems designed to permanently disable the sensors that make modern drones so effective.
Instead of chasing every drone with an expensive interceptor it blinds the drone using a Pulsed Laser Air Defense system (PLAID) which uses ultrashort bursts of energy to target a drone's optical sensor. Because the system focuses on defeating the sensor in milliseconds rather than physically destroying the aircraft, it offers the potential to counter large numbers of autonomous systems without the cost and logistical burden associated with traditional air defense.
That's the kind of thinking modern warfare demands.
Technologies like advanced lasers and directed-energy weapons offer the potential to defeat large numbers of drones quickly and at significantly lower cost. If successful, they could become an essential layer in protecting military installations, critical infrastructure, and civilian populations.
But no single technology will determine the future of warfare.
What matters is whether America can build a defense ecosystem that moves at the speed of modern conflict. National security is ultimately about people. It's about protecting the servicemembers who volunteer to defend this country and giving military families confidence that their loved ones have the best tools available if they are ever called into harm's way. It's also about transitioning veterans who still want to serve and live a purpose driven life. Some of the most important defense innovations today are being built by former servicemembers who understand the battlefield from personal experience. Their expertise helps bridge the gap between emerging technology and real-world military needs.
Eighty-six years ago, Roosevelt challenged America to become the arsenal of democracy.
If we want to live up to that slogan, we'll need to keep up the pace of production.

Peter,
A new bombshell just dropped from the New York Times and it's horrifying.
The report gave a rare insight into the deliberations of the senior aides and sycophants surrounding Trump, and the depraved depths they are willing to go to implement the administration's fascist agenda--suspension of constitutional rights and full scale military invasions of U.S. cities.
It was revealed that in the early months of the Trump administration, advisor Stephen Miller was pushing behind the scenes for the suspension of habeas corpus, the constitutional right that guarantees a fair trial when detained by the government, as a part of their extreme immigration crackdown.
It was also revealed that Vice President J.D. Vance pushed for the invocation of the Insurrection Act after the coldblooded murder of Alex Pretti in Minnesota by federal agents, which would have allowed Donald Trump to deploy the U.S. Military in democrat run cities and states.

| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001V3QG75IVtZQt0PZLVLdY7MZFKx9nlvdYu5bEekxQ9WVWAPi-rxrs59X3Vl3Fbp8_SU27lkmMQQeO8-dAZYnXKQVP5cyw6KX1xTqUX90mOtASucHxB_mLMiA6fuY3DX6VFrlmXlp9fhIhuCHVAOsT8HUdCFtN1WLmxUb-T052-u4oG39nZIh85UlUweWEJlJurjdWBs0KrqimncFXq0wFRHuQUQpJWvH4U0MCNEPZAeA=&c=WSPLB948FVXxRo3KIpvGaip_AhLmD3lDnVTcHTPj-5mrFtO2jRpPOQ==&ch=u12wiQe82xAQmvue0tZ06LhwKU77-fDUZVJsxlQKvR07ve9dBjOH6w==)

This is why we're so concerned about November. We've been sounding the alarm about the Trump administration's election rigging scheme since Spring of last year. Trump and his cronies are willing to do anything for power and now we know for a fact how far they're willing to go--suspension of constitutional rights, effectively implementing martial law.
What happens when the election results don't go their way in November?
That's why Defend Our Courts is leading the fight to counter Trump's election rigging plot on every front. We're defending and building majorities on state Supreme Courts, the courts with final say over election laws in their states. We're also paving the path to reform and rebalance the U.S. Supreme Court by backing Democrats in key House and Senate races this November. subject: Republican Congressional Candidate Justin Story Commends Federal and State Leaders for Aggressive Response to New World Screwworm Threat
body:
Justin Story praises President Trump, Secretary Rollins, Governor DeSantis, and Commissioner Simpson for taking swift action to protect Florida ag

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/TGHqyeh2bP1?e=90ad5fc3c5&c2id=d60c3f7cebee07fc4dcb3011da999329)
| | | | | |
**PRESS RELEASE**

**Republican Congressional Candidate Justin Story Commends Federal and State Leaders for Aggressive Response to New World Screwworm Threat******
_Justin Story praises President Trump, Secretary Rollins, Governor DeSantis, and Commissioner Simpson for taking swift action to protect Florida agriculture and livestock from the growing threat of the New World Screwworm.____**“ Pressures from developers, ever-growing bureaucratic red tape, and now a pest that was eradicated in the 1960s, the New World Screwworm, are making the agriculture way of life harder and harder to sustain. Your desire to work the land and to be the stewards of Florida’s environment and natural beauty is commendable. As the candidate for Congress representing the heart of Florida’s beef production, I will fight in Washington to preserve our way of life.” – Justin Story **_
---
|
---
| | **June 16, 2026****Contact: justin@votejustinstory.com**
---
| |
(**St. Cloud, Florida**) — Today, Justin Story, Republican candidate for Congress in Florida's 9th Congressional District, issued the following statement regarding federal and state efforts to prevent the spread of the New World Screwworm and protect Florida's farmers, ranchers, livestock, and agricultural economy from this emerging threat.
---
| |
“I commend Governor Ron DeSantis and Florida Commissioner of Agriculture Wilton Simpson for their decisive, proactive leadership in response to the New World Screwworm detections in Texas and New Mexico. Governor DeSantis quickly expanded the state’s emergency response to include this threat, while Commissioner Simpson has implemented strong emergency rules to restrict the importation of warm-blooded animals from high-risk areas. These steps including veterinary checks, treatments, and limits on animal movement, are protecting our state from this devastating parasite.
“I also want to praise President Donald Trump and U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins for their strong federal leadership on this issue. Secretary Rollins has been on the front lines by launching the New World Screwworm Grand Challenge, accelerating sterile fly production and releases, investing in containment and eradication efforts, and coordinating rapid response with states and partners. Under President Trump’s administration, USDA is treating this as the national security and agricultural security priority it is, pushing back hard against the threat while holding previous weak border policies accountable.
"This threat highlights the urgent need for strong border security. Weak borders and insufficient inspections allow pests, diseases, and other risks to enter our country too easily. We must secure the southern border, enhance agricultural screenings, and prevent these threats from reaching the farms and ranches of Florida’s 9th Congressional District.
"I will fight in Congress for full federal support of USDA APHIS sterile insect programs, enhanced surveillance, rapid-response funding, and resources tailored to districts like ours." With President Trump, Secretary Rollins, Governor DeSantis, and Commissioner Simpson leading the way, we have the team to win this fight at every level.
To our farming and ranching families across Orange, Okeechobee, Highlands, Glades, Indian River, Polk, Osceola, and the rest of CD-9: "In today’s crazy world, our farmers and ranchers face more risks than ever before. Pressures from developers, ever-growing bureaucratic red tape, and now a pest that was eradicated in the 1960s, the New World Screwworm, are making the agriculture way of life harder and harder to sustain. Your desire to work the land and to be the stewards of Florida’s environment and natural beauty is commendable. As the candidate for Congress representing the heart of Florida’s beef production, I will fight in Washington to preserve our way of life. I look forward to serving you in Congress. Thank you for keeping us fed."
---
| | Justin Story is a 6th Generation Central Floridian, retired Marine Corps officer, former F/A-18 fighter pilot. For further information, visit VoteJustinStory.com or contact justin@votejustinstory.com. ###

# RPT Recap!
| |
---
|
---
The Republican Party of Texas Biennial Convention wrapped up late Saturday afternoon, and **Team TFVC made an indelible impact from start to finish.** President Rebecca Hardy and Political Director Emily Cameron arrived in Houston on Sunday afternoon to prepare for committee hearings the following day. The first half of the week was **spent testifying before and working alongside the Platform and Legislative Priorities Committees and Subcommittees** to help shape the future of the Republican Party. Our goal was clear: secure **strong medical liberty language in both the Party Platform and among the Legislative Priorities** for the 2027 Legislature to tackle. We're pleased to report that, thanks to the hard work of delegates leading up to convention and TFVC's contributions in these critical committee rooms, **Medical Freedom earned a place among the 15 Legislative Priorities** advanced to the full convention body for a vote. We expect to learn which eight priorities ultimately make the final list soon and will, of course, keep you posted. Regardless of the official outcome, one thing is abundantly clear: **support for our mission is stronger than ever.** The enthusiasm for medical liberty among the several thousand attendees was impossible to miss, and the fact that our issue advanced into the Top 15 is a **powerful testament to how far we've come since TFVC was founded in 2015.** _But the RPT Convention wasn't all business._ Our Wednesday night pre-party featuring **guest of honor Jennifer Bridges, RN** , set the tone for the rest of the week. Her heartfelt words of gratitude for Team TFVC were deeply appreciated. (Back atcha, Jennifer!) In the convention hall, TFVC staff members Carrie Bigford, Kelly Vela, and Yvette Whitcher, alongside an army of dedicated volunteers, **operated our eye-catching and engaging booth** , helping spread the message of medical liberty to thousands of attendees. Our **"podcast corner"** created opportunities for meaningful conversations with legislators, candidates, and conservative influencers about why Texas must lead the nation on vaccine choice. We also welcomed **medical liberty hero Dr. Mary Talley Bowden for a special Thursday Meet & Greet**, where she shared her experiences fighting medical tyranny and encouraged attendees to remain engaged in the battle ahead. And then came the **unexpected cherry on top: Rob Schneider** made an unannounced appearance in the exhibit hall and completely upended his schedule to sit down with Team TFVC for an interview! While convention week may be over, TFVC's work is not... _**We are deeply grateful for the opportunity to partner with you in the fight for medical liberty in Texas, and we're more energized than ever for what comes next.**_

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Ohio Democrat gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton's campaign has been paying Ohioans for event attendance and endorsements, according to Ohio campaign finance expenditure records.

Even more disturbing, Acton's campaign has made payments to labor union political committees around the same time some of those unions endorsed her campaign, raising serious questions about whether Acton's support in Ohio is organic or manufactured.

Ohio Secretary of State campaign finance disclosure expenditure records show that on March 20, 2026, Amy Acton's committee, Ohioans for Amy Acton and David Pepper, paid $250 for "event attendance" to the Committee for Terri Jamison. That committee is connected to Judge Terri Jamison, the incumbent elected judge of the Ohio Tenth District Court of Appeals, who is running for reelection in 2026.
Just three days later, on March 23, 2026, Amy Acton for Governor paid $420 for "event attendance" to Brit Steiner for Ohio, the campaign committee supporting Brit Steiner, a Democrat candidate for Ohio House District 49.

Records from the Ohio Democrat Party show that Ohioans for Amy Acton and David Pepper, Amy Acton for Governor, and Ohioans for Amy Acton are the same committee. Acton simply changed the name of the committee after David Pepper became her running mate.

But the potential malfeasance does not stop there.
Ohio campaign finance data also shows that Ohioans for Amy Acton paid for a "candidate endorsement," giving $1,000 to an organization known as The Matriots in February 2026. According to The Matriots' [website](https://substack.com/redirect/c43cf06f-bd3f-44ac-99f9-f36c092714ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the organization endorses women regardless of political party, but it appears to be another reprehensible example of a systematic "pay for endorsements" scheme.

---|---|---
On February 25, 2026, the Acton-Pepper committee sent $2,500 directly to the Ohio Nurses Association PCE. On April 29, 2026, the Ohio Nurses Association officially[ endorsed](https://substack.com/redirect/0e4cc012-65c0-43fb-b76b-fe094de71140?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Amy Acton, just over two months after receiving the cash.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b2474a4-950a-4736-ad5e-477b7fe1639a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
SEIU appears to have received a similar arrangement from the Acton campaign.
On March 26, 2026, Ohioans for Amy Acton and David Pepper wired $16,615.97 to SEIU District 1199 PCE. Just 19 days later, on April 14, 2026, Acton sent another $16,615.97 to SEIU District 1199 PAC. Additional payments of $16,615.97 each were made on May 7, 2026, to both SEIU District 1199 PCE and SEIU District 1199 PAC.
SEIU District 1199 announced its endorsement of Amy Acton on April 8, 2026, with Acton's official campaign press release dated April 9, 2026. Acton also lists SEIU 1199's endorsement on her official campaign [website](https://substack.com/redirect/04f92507-0cc5-4945-9039-c0cccac0b97d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9bad8249-9e4b-4a23-95fb-562ccc5e4458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But perhaps the most obvious example of Acton's alleged pay-for-endorsements operation occurred on March 26, 2026. Ohio campaign finance records show the committee Ohioans for Amy Acton and David Pepper paid $16,615.67 to IBEW 683 PCE.
That same day, Amy Acton posted that she was "deeply honored" to receive the IBEW endorsement.
What a coincidence.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/134ea8bc-df2e-44d3-b479-907d1edc8577?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Acton's committee also sent several payments to the Ohio AFL-CIO Voter Education Fund after the Ohio AFL-CIO endorsed her. Ohio campaign finance records show payments of $2,500 on February 24, 2026, $10,000 on March 17, 2026, and $4,115 on April 7, 2026.
On February 16, 2026, Cincinnati media[ reported](https://substack.com/redirect/49592857-eb3f-4fc0-9269-6396caef2df3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the Ohio AFL-CIO had already endorsed Acton, "rebuking Vivek Ramaswamy."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b7afbb66-7514-4f0c-b34b-3dfa15952d35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Acton's campaign was cutting checks to major labor-aligned political entities before, during, and after key endorsement announcements.
This is not how a candidate with real grassroots support behaves. This is how the Democrat machine manufactures momentum and influences the media narrative.
President Donald Trump won Ohio by more than 10 points twice. **Democrats do not have a credible statewide base of support in the Buckeye state, and Amy Acton 's campaign knows it.** That explains why Acton's operation is relying on paid event attendance, paid "candidate endorsement" expenses, union political payments, and Kamala Harris-style astroturfing to create the illusion that Ohioans are lining up behind her campaign.
They are not.
Amy Acton is not running a grassroots movement. She is running a campaign based on manufactured enthusiasm and endorsements.
Amy Acton is running a pay-to-play Democrat operation straight out of the Democrat machine's playbook. Ohio voters deserve to know exactly who is getting paid, when they are getting paid, and what Acton's campaign is receiving in return.

body:
Imagine growing up in a country where owning a Bible is illegal.
| | | | June 16, 2026 | [Read online](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/BdihfVlLre6boyebryJXjfCzQBKU%2F0X4MzYn1pCGUsR2P3i%2FaXs46mNY%2BBKQ%0Av0xeNTkO073XDxiht2AmqGPawH9zt5oXCXfs7aDIm3VHso1YcqpbudrGCGbJ%0AymLKZDBhAkUcdNZQZb6UN0WOW9Jn4pPKdoGHeDySqpHiYIck5n9%2BgtcciOuJ%0A56I6CRBObYAHbv9rgCjhkGC4ALR0bKr7Gg%3D%3D%0A/5344b8e12dcd8eb9)

# Tuesday, June 16, 2026
---
| Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes
# Just The Truth
Your No-BS Newsletter Dear Readers, Today's sponsor, the International Mission Board, is preparing to share the Gospel with visitors from around the world during the upcoming World Cup by equipping outreach teams with resources, discipleship tools, and opportunities to engage people who may never have encountered Christianity freely in their home countries. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
* * *
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/gxj6G6Y1ZFeFZUaq0wwOvt9bAHSWwXg5zBV1Otv7tEaJRnPGJ1VPdXdkE0x3%0A7yEZ5XIlQtFDYJtNt5f0s7yRHzsCUdQ8zGlY3QqxE5LC7fQcDCC6s1t2RIE7%0Ah7SsL7VpTlOaLcInkvhU8AwVeILMz5YLHYQAoUJF9Mw%2FdDFRQr0csruSyYfF%0A%2FbNj1W7ZLn5lGGMx45SFkF%2FRZcqkpKccGA%3D%3D%0A/3b4ffeca3a7809d1)Dear Friend,Imagine growing up in a country where owning a Bible is illegal.Where the name of Jesus is not spoken in public. Where choosing to follow Christ could cost you your family, your job, or your freedom. Where a missionary can’t get a visa.For millions of people, this is not a hypothetical. It is everyday life.This summer, many of them are coming to the World Cup.They are coming to cheer for their national team and experience something larger than themselves. When they arrive in cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, they will step into something they never experienced before — a place where someone can walk up to them, hand them a Gospel of John in their language, and tell them about Jesus without anyone stopping it._This moment is what we are preparing for._ IMB teams will be on the ground in Fan Zones and near stadiums throughout the tournament. Trained volunteers will be ready to have conversations, distribute resources, and connect fans with digital discipleship tools in their language that they can take home — back to countries where that kind of follow-up would otherwise be impossible.For some of these fans, this will be the only time in their lives they are handed the gospel freely.We cannot show up unprepared.You can help us be ready by giving a gift today.Here is what your gift does:
* $25 — 200 evangelism tracts placed directly into the hands of fans
* $50 — 25 soccer patches for sparking evangelistic conversations
* $100 — 100 Gospel of John booklets
* $250 — Rents an English Club outreach location where fans can hear the gospel in a welcoming space

At the Paris Olympics and the Winter Olympics, this approach worked. Thousands of spiritual conversations occurred. Tens of thousands of New Testaments were distributed. People made commitments to Christ during conversations with our teams. People interested in the gospel connected with discipleship tools that followed them home to their own countries.The World Cup is far-reaching. The opportunity to connect with people who have never had access to hear the gospel is greater than anything we have seen at a single event.But only if we are there, fully funded and fully prepared.**Will you give today to ensure our teams are on the ground and ready for the World Cup?**[**Click here to give.**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/v1/c/i39WzxEY4ICfYY3f2Hay88FO35eIQHW0Eizw7h78q942hIrOdfnIkiru1Uhy%0A4SlTH6egn8wQBApTxpR9mhHoxMmXJpbLqhLxHPdWxJ%2Fe4%2FFW2inJYqcNP9HQ%0A11uryZEjl79wJchZXe%2F%2BC4h2RcBZ7Pi0DwJZLdulhhl71e%2B4Lgjv975imi8a%0AI%2Bw4%2FtLc1MQ0GWtKPcjt4lhU6ol%2BS%2FEf4Q%3D%3D%0A/273eb9f31804ca2e) Grateful for you,

Angie Shepherd
Journeyman Alumni
Prayer and Missions Advocate International Mission Board | 3806 Monument Ave.
Richmond, VA 23230 | (804) 353-0515

Migrants stabbed, choked, 2 killed. One month before, our MAGA Gov. called for totalitarian prison camps.
| | | | | [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0012X6Gd3txR-44w_7tWhzGTGod23jziFec8H6Outljsjz4ut8VAbHITrosywH-ftlX0dnaBnITWaDrE5QfnAJZyzuMEZDXioKb7khQxFfkVRcuKKgqHfrLNgK6dntBrx1TbHdQHFtoBHiJjj5xFOq37-W3pzf5jvtjUqte68C4hb7sJEDNF0xRmhfn53Z2odOL8MVxXSHg-bFSbbqACsEIpXWFP_0ri9sw&c=-CJdsQ1s_8HFBc1AZCbDRh60CeCKvOJq8MEHlXChSZTn1sghqG3iGg==&ch=x9OsKcv4UKcUl__sgqZGiTkJU4uvWsz6xvdHui2tKPBwfBS-Cguctw==)

| Peter,
Earlier this year, the Inspector General for the Department of Homeland Security conducted a surprise visit at Winn Correctional Center, an ICE facility (although more akin to a War on Terror black site), in North Louisiana.
What they found was shocking. A migrant stabbed with a pen, another choked out, and just last week they reported the 2nd migrant death in less than two months.

---
This comes on the heels of Louisiana's extremist Governor's remark, "we've got eighteen thousand acres at Angola prison, if it were up to me I'd send them all there for the rest of their lives."
This is the model of subjugation that MAGA hopes to export across the country and it is being beta tested in Louisiana.
Abortion? Felony murder.
Homeless? Year in jail or treatment and a year of working off your debt with a state work crew living in work camps.
Immigrant? Torture or death at an ICE black site.
They wanted another House seat -- MAGA sent the National Guard to New Orleans. They declared a 'State of Emergency.' Cancelled our election. And erased one of our Black majority districts to make it majority white.
They hope we will be so scared that we don't stop their power grabs. They aren't stopping here. And if we can't defeat them in Louisiana, God help us all.
My name is Jamie Davis, I'm the Democrat running for US Senate here in Louisiana, I'm a farmer working the same land my great grandfather worked as a sharecropper. My family has poured too much blood into this soil for us to pack up and move somewhere else.
I refuse to let them turn my beloved Louisiana into a prison state. I have to take a stand and fight for the way of life that we had when I grew up here as a boy. body:
We have a lot of work to do if we plan on making these predictions come true.
|

Peter, I have great news to share:
Right now, the polls are showing me with a razor-thin lead in North Carolina’s Senate race.
I’m glad to hear it, but we can’t use this as an excuse to sit back and rest on our laurels until November – not when North Carolina hasn’t sent a Democrat to the Senate in 18 years. Polls can’t predict the future. They only show how people feel right now.
**We’ll know the final answer on election night.[Can you please chip in now to help us make it come true?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk686-v1&amount=5&t=8&akid=1759%2E124072%2EdMBAno)**

---
We have a ways to go until then, though – and while I’ve never lost an election, Washington DC Republicans are doing everything in their power to change that. With far-right super PACs already making eight-figure ad buys to smear me over the airwaves, we have **a lot** of work to do.
We need to knock on doors, call voters and keep our ads running on the airwaves. We need to make sure North Carolinians know the truth. I’m no stranger to winning tough races, so trust me when I say that none of this work will be possible without grassroots support from folks like you.

| The most important Senate race on the map.
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2495%2E259176%2EMOL0q5) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2495%2E259176%2EMOL0q5)_

Because they know — if they can buy Michigan’s open U.S. Senate seat, they block the Democrats from having _any_ chance at flipping control of the U.S. Senate to serve as a real check on Trump. It’s a massive amount of money aimed directly at defeating **us**. _They think they can buy this seat._ [**We need the resources to fight back right now.
