body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2396%2E5691347%2EZFqYPi)

Peter, it’s Jon.
You probably didn’t wake up this morning hoping to read yet another fundraising email. But since you’re here...
If you’re ready to help make sure I have the resources to fight back against everything right-wing Super PACs and the President throw at me, you can use this link now: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ossoff-em-jun26**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260616-1-f&t=2&akid=2396%2E5691347%2EZFqYPi)
If you need a little more convincing, here’s the story of my first Senate race.
Six years ago, we held here in Georgia one of the most consequential Senate elections of all time.
It was two for one.
The Jewish kid and the Black pastor, running together, with a massive grassroots movement alongside us.
They said we couldn’t win. Do you remember?
But we built one of the most powerful movements in Georgia’s history.
You picked me up and you picked Raphael up, and you carried us on your shoulders.
_Do you remember how it felt to fight and to win?_
Maybe right now you feel surrounded by darkness.
You might be a little numb. Wondering whether there’s a way out.
But folks: **we don’t have the luxury of despair.**
Because no matter who wins the Republican runoff, my opponent will be nothing more than another Trump puppet in the Senate, deepening Republican _capitulation to the most corrupt and incompetent president in American history._
_He wants to put his face on the money!_ My opponents will rubber stamp whatever “His Majesty” demands.
Both of my opponents are pro-war. Pro-tariff. Pro-cutting your health care. Pro-slush fund. Pro-ballroom.
They’ll join the Senate Republicans who prove every day there is no bottom to their debasement and humiliation.
**A landslide victory in 2026 is our only hope to recover Congressional power and reverse this descent toward one-man rule.**
And here in Georgia, I am the only Democratic U.S. Senator nationwide up for reelection in a state Trump won.
I am therefore MAGA’s #1 target for defeat.
**_There is no path back without defending this seat — the seat that secured the Democratic majority back in 2021._**
So I'm asking for your help. Not for me, for all of us.
**I really need your help right now.**
[**Please consider contributing to my campaign straight away.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260616-1-f&t=3&akid=2396%2E5691347%2EZFqYPi)
With gratitude,
Senator Jon Ossoff

Hi Derek, I know I reached out last night, but I wanted to follow up with you: We came up six percent short of our $350,000 mid-month goal. After I reached out, this team got us three percent closer to our goal, and I'm grateful. But we still need to close the gap today, before midnight. So I hope you’ll give me a chance to explain why goals like these matter, especially right now. This is a longer message, but it is important and, in a minute, I’m going to [**personally ask for your support.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260616_7592_fr&refcode2=7592_22930333_c-Hz20&akid=7592%2E22930333%2Ec-Hz20) **[CHIP IN](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-june-2026-gfr?amount=7refcode=em_20260616_7592_fr&refcode2=7592_22930333_c-Hz20&akid=7592%2E22930333%2Ec-Hz20)** November’s midterm elections are right around the corner. Because of people just like you, we were able to launch our new When We Count program, which is already working to register more than 250,000 new Democratic voters in key battlegrounds. We know that to win anywhere, we have to organize everywhere. That’s exactly what we’re doing, but we need your support to keep going. Democrats have won or overperformed in **_almost 90%**_ of key elections since Trump took office. These victories were only possible because we made historic investments in organizing, registering new Democratic voters, and contesting races in every corner of the country. Grassroots supporters like you made those investments happen. And Derek, along with all the other work that we’re leading ahead of November, the DNC is also holding Trump accountable in the courts. We filed a new lawsuit to stop Trump from illegally restricting vote-by-mail and our legal team is using every tool at their disposal to defend Americans’ voting rights. As you can imagine, all of this work takes a massive amount of resources. This team has always stepped up when we’ve asked for your help, and I’m asking for your support one more time to keep funding our work. Democrats have won or overperformed in almost 90% of key elections since Trump took office. These victories were only possible because we made historic investments in organizing, registering new Democratic voters, and contesting races in every corner of the country. **PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Peter,
Freedom Fest is now just **10 days away.**
Over the past several weeks, we've announced an incredible lineup of speakers, entertainers, and special guests. We've also listened carefully to your feedback and made major changes to make Freedom Fest more accessible than ever.

_**New Simplified Ticket Pricing**_ We've reduced and simplified our ticket options:
**🥉 Bronze Pass – $45**
_Championship Rodeo, Curtis Grimes Concert, Family Fun Festival, Food Trucks, and Candidate Meet & Greet._
**🥈 Silver Pass – $95**
_Everything in Bronze PLUS all Friday and Saturday speakers, including Greg Gutfeld!_
**🥇 Gold Pass – $195**
_Everything in Silver PLUS the Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Secretary Chris Wright, Nick Shirley, Larry Gatlin, and our Drone Show Finale._
**💎 Platinum VIP – $495**
_Everything in Gold PLUS VIP seating, parking, and photo opportunities._
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

|

**🌟 HONORING THOSE WHO SERVE**
One of the most meaningful parts of Freedom Fest is the opportunity to bring together Americans who have sacrificed for our country and communities.
**We're launching a special initiative to identify:** 🇺🇸 Veterans 🇺🇸 Active Duty Military 🇺🇸 Gold Star Families 🇺🇸 First Responders ...who would love to attend Freedom Fest but may need financial assistance to make it happen.
Several generous supporters have already stepped forward and offered to sponsor tickets. A limited number of sponsored tickets will be available.

If you'd like to nominate someone deserving, _**reply to this email.**_
|
---
**📣 BECOME A VOLUNTEER**
If you believe in what we're building, we'd love your help.
We're currently looking for volunteers to help make Freedom Fest a success. Volunteers who commit to a single 4-hour shift will receive _**complimentary day passes for both days of the festival**_ (evening events not included), allowing you to experience Freedom Fest while helping create something truly special for Colorado. There are a limited number of spots so grab yours before it's too late!
Whether you're greeting guests, assisting vendors, helping in VIP areas, or simply lending a hand where needed, you'll play a part in building what we believe will be the largest freedom-focused celebration Colorado has ever seen.
Interested in volunteering? Reply to this email and we'll connect you with our volunteer team.
[VOLUNTEER AT FREEDOM FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

Freedom Fest wouldn't be possible without the organizations helping us bring this celebration to Colorado.

**The Heritage Foundation** _America's leading conservative policy organization and home of some of Freedom Fest's featured speakers._

Colorado's home for conservative talk radio and a longtime partner in promoting faith, freedom, and common-sense values.

We’re a small but mighty team working through an enormous amount of excitement and ticket demand. If you need assistance, please contact us:

name: Jahana Hayes
subject: My "no" vote is a demand for real reform.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Jahana Hayes
body:
An agency operating with impunity just received billions more. I refused. | | Friend, Last week, House Republicans voted to hand $70 billion more to Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection, on top of the $140 billion they received last year from H.R.1 — _with no new reforms, no oversight, and no accountability._ **I voted no, and have been clear about exactly why.** I refuse to funnel more money into ICE while public trust in the agency has eroded. This bill fails to address a single systemic failure. It doesn't stop the detention of American citizens, nor does it require agents to identify themselves, wear body cameras, or adhere to the Constitution. The documented patterns of excessive force and secrecy are horrifying. For too long, unchecked congressional funding has allowed the Department of Homeland Security to operate as a dangerous agency with total impunity. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act already allocated enough to fund DHS for nearly seven years — including $75 billion for ICE. There is simply no honest justification for another $70 billion. This vote lands on top of Republicans tearing health care and food assistance away from children, seniors, and veterans — the deepest cuts to Medicaid and nutrition aid in our history — even as the price of groceries, rent, and gas keeps climbing. We can secure our borders and enforce our laws while also protecting civil rights and public safety. clean_body: An agency operating with impunity just received billions more. I refused. | | Friend, Last week, House Republicans voted to hand $70 billion more to Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection, on top of the $140 billion they received last year from H.R.1 — with no new reforms, no oversight, and no accountability. I voted no, and have been clear about exactly why. I refuse to funnel more money into ICE while public trust in the agency has eroded. This bill fails to address a single systemic failure. It doesn't stop the detention of American citizens, nor does it require agents to identify themselves, wear body cameras, or adhere to the Constitution. The documented patterns of excessive force and secrecy are horrifying. For too long, unchecked congressional funding has allowed the Department of Homeland Security to operate as a dangerous agency with total impunity. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act already allocated enough to fund DHS for nearly seven years — including $75 billion for ICE. There is simply no honest justification for another $70 billion. This vote lands on top of Republicans tearing health care and food assistance away from children, seniors, and veterans — the deepest cuts to Medicaid and nutrition aid in our history — even as the price of groceries, rent, and gas keeps climbing. We can secure our borders and enforce our laws while also protecting civil rights and public safety. These goals are not in conflict. But Congress must finally declare that cruelty and lawlessness are unacceptable. My "no" vote is a demand for real reform. A single vote in Washington isn't enough to stop this. The night after Trump put an octagon on sacred ground, the Senate confirmed a judge and went home. The House was out of town. This is what our Democratic opposition looks like.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/afde9f4f-0c34-40ba-a2dd-af3e5b64c27a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
UFC Freedom 250 Event @ The White House
I've been sitting with something since Sunday night and I'd like to take a moment to explain it to you.
Sunday was Flag Day, and Donald Trump converted the South Lawn of the White House into a UFC octagon.
He staged seven professional fights on grounds paid for by 250 years of American blood on the holiday that honors the flag those people died under.
The Armed Forces Joint Chorus sang the National Anthem.
Honor Guards stood at the Lincoln Memorial as props for the fighters' entrance.
The closed captioning was sponsored by [TrumpCoins.com](https://substack.com/redirect/bded4af2-919c-4eb2-b426-eaab863eee54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), marketed during the National Anthem, at the White House.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f11fde-2b82-489c-89cb-d446feec3fa9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
1oz. UFC Medallion: $11,999
The optics of that fight mean more in the context of what this administration wants you to believe about your role, and your rights, as Americans. It was the systematic conversion of national symbols into personal property, conducted in plain sight, designed to make you feel like a guest at something you already own. The point of all of it was to make you forget that lawn or that House even belongs to you.
The desecration that happened Sunday night is endless. But perhaps more unsettling to me is the lack of Democratic response to it at all.
Now, I've heard the argument. I've made it myself, honestly. The math isn't there. Impeachment requires a House majority Democrats don't have. Removal requires two-thirds of the Senate. You don't win votes you don't have.
But I'd be misreading something important if I chalked what happened up to the math. The math explains why Democrats can't remove Trump this week. But it doesn't explain the silence or why the most powerful legislative minority in the world -- which has the right to take the floor, to build the public record, to make the case day after day until the political cost of silence on the other side exceeds the cost of action -- is scheduling routine judicial confirmations the morning after the president staged a birthday fight card on the people's front lawn.
That silence has an explanation. It's just not one the party wants to admit to.
My perspective comes from direct experience inside the Democratic Party: as a congressional candidate in Ohio's 7th District, as a three-term local party representative in my county, and as someone who has seen how party structures operate from the inside.

What I learned in that campaign, and what I learn more deeply every week I spend reporting this newsletter -- is that the Democratic Party's silence is not a product of powerlessness. It is a product of a donor class that has made a calculation that sustained disruption is bad for business, and a party structure so corrupted by corporate money that it has accepted that calculation as its operating premise.
* * *
#### The Difference Between Powerlessness and Refusal

Let me tell you what fighting from the minority actually looks like. Because, the history is unambiguous on this.
In 1857, the Supreme Court handed down [Dred Scott v. Sandford](https://substack.com/redirect/0846603c-5911-48e6-b3d9-3b096b7eb1ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- one of the most shameful decisions in the Court's history -- holding that Black people were not citizens under the Constitution and that Congress had no authority to prohibit slavery in the federal territories. The Republican Party was then a minority coalition. The math wasn't there. The situation looked impossible. But, they refused to accept it.
They built their case in public, year after year, election after election, treating an unjust ruling not as a permanent condition to be managed but as a moral emergency to be fought. They didn't wait for favorable math. They built the math. They ratified the 13th, 14th, and 15th Amendments and superseded Dred Scott entirely.
Congress has done this before and since. A 1991 amendment to Title VII overruled more than a dozen Supreme Court decisions in a single piece of legislation. [The Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act ](https://substack.com/redirect/4e1e3426-4ab4-440a-b2b6-5aa4e4726d21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- the first bill Barack Obama signed into law -- overturned a Supreme Court decision simply by rewriting the statute, because Democrats spent years building public pressure around an unjust ruling rather than accepting it as permanent.
But the precedent that matters most right now is not a Supreme Court override.
Its August 7, 1974.
On that day, three senior Republican leaders -- [Senator Barry Goldwater, Senate Republican Leader Hugh Scott, and House Republican Leader John Rhodes](https://substack.com/redirect/245fc435-15e8-4796-ab95-6371b99799fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) -- walked into the Oval Office and told Richard Nixon he had no more than 15 votes for acquittal in a Senate trial. Nixon resigned the next day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82387a5d-ce06-403b-828d-fbe78569aea9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Senator Barry Goldwater](https://substack.com/redirect/2734e414-3b46-4b7b-a94a-3139028854f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That meeting didn't happen because Republicans spontaneously developed a conscience. It happened because Democrats spent two years building a case so relentless and so publicly documented that the political cost of continuing to defend Nixon exceeded the cost of abandoning him.
They didn't wait for Republicans to feel shame. They made shame unavoidable. They built the Goldwater coalition through the grinding, daily, undeniable accumulation of the public record.
**That is the model. Not a fundraising email. Not a work period. That.**
* * *
#### Outrage Is Not a Strategy

In April, more than 70 Democratic lawmakers called for impeachment or the 25th Amendment after Trump threatened to wipe out a civilization. [Senators Murphy, Markey, and Kim said plainly the president should be removed.](https://substack.com/redirect/3a301b47-331b-42b3-a772-3e54415e4f85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Then the Senate scheduled a judicial confirmation and the House went home. That is what happens when a party fights in bursts rather than sustained campaigns.
When outrage is treated as a fundraising moment rather than the beginning of a long accountability project.
When the donor class -- which funds the candidates and shapes what the party can and cannot say -- decides the moment has passed and it's time to return to normal operations.
**Normal operations.**
While a man who calls dead soldiers losers stages birthday parties on the people's front lawn.
While the VA loses 40,000 employees.
While 1.2 million veterans lose their provider.
While the East Wing is replaced with a ballroom and the South Lawn gets an octagon.
**Normal operations.**
* * *
#### What I keep coming back to is this:

The Democratic Party has the tools to fight.
It has the history.
It has the constitutional mandate.
It has the floor.
What it does not have -- what the insiders who run it have systematically ensured it doesn't have -- is the will to use those tools in a way that genuinely disrupts the people who pay for the party.
That is the problem! Not the math. Not the rules. Not the structural constraints of minority status.
The problem is that the insiders who run the Democratic Party have decided that a certain level of Trump is manageable -- preferable, even, to the kind of sustained confrontation that might threaten existing donor relationships, existing power arrangements, the existing understanding of who this party serves and what it is actually for.
My family has sent someone to fight in every war this country has ever had. **Every one!** Going back to the Revolution. What they were owed for that -- what every military family was owed -- was a government that takes seriously its obligation to fight for them. A party that treats their sacrifice as more than a backdrop for a pay-per-view event and more than a subject line in a fundraising email.
Today the Senate confirmed a judge.
The House went home.
The South Lawn still has an octagon on it.
The UFC fight last night and the empty Senate floor today are not two separate stories. They are the same story. They are both about what happens when power goes unchecked -- when one party acts without limits because the other has decided, at the donor level, that a certain level of restraint is the safer bet.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a70c0925-7a57-4a5b-aac7-166a00687892?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Empty Senate floor
We need floor speeches every day. About the unconstitutional war in Iran. About $410 billion in impounded taxpayer money. About the illegal detention of American citizens. About 1.2 million veterans without a VA provider. About what happened to the East Wing. About what happened on the South Lawn on Flag Day.
We need the Goldwater coalition -- the Republicans whose political survival no longer depends on enabling this president, built through daily, documented, relentless public accountability that makes silence on the other side unsustainable.
We need a Democratic Party that understands what Barry Goldwater understood in 1974: you don't wait for the math to be right.
You make it right.

And..

### June 16, 2026 Newsletter

| |
## 8 Reasons We’re Celebrating American Dads
---
| |
---
| | This Father’s Day, we’re honoring the men who help shape families, strengthen communities, and influence the future of our nation. While no dad is perfect, fathers who are present, committed, and growing alongside their families provide something truly irreplaceable. From protecting and providing to teaching life lessons and creating unforgettable memories, dads play a unique role in the lives of their children. Research consistently shows that involved fathers help foster emotional stability, confidence, academic success, and healthier relationships later in life. Fathers are often the ones teaching practical skills, modeling perseverance, and showing children how to navigate both success and failure. They bring laughter through their legendary dad jokes, courage through their example, and wisdom through years of experience. For sons, dads provide a living model of manhood, responsibility, and integrity. For daughters, they often become the first example of how a woman should be valued and treated. Their influence echoes far beyond childhood. Perhaps most importantly, fathers who live out their faith create a lasting spiritual legacy. Through everyday moments and life's greatest challenges, they demonstrate resilience, hope, and trust in God. And through it all, dads rarely give up. They cheer us on, guide us through mistakes, celebrate our victories, and quietly leave a mark on generations to come. This week, we’re saying thank you to the fathers, husbands, grandfathers, and father figures who make history every day—not from positions of fame, but through the lives they shape at home. Discover the 8 reasons we’re celebrating dads, along with the inspiring story of Theodore Roosevelt’s devotion to fatherhood, in our [full blog](https://momsforamerica.us/so/bePxGn3Ft/c?w=UPA6xYVEykxc_H0VBcSV7RhxzuR9-iv2VjJWullTbQo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiJhYWU1NzA5YS03YzJhLTQ4MTktOGYzNC00NzViNWEzMzM0MjkiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ) on the website.

| | The Essential Role of Fathers
---
| |
---
| | At Moms for America, we often highlight the vital role of mothers, but strong families also require strong fathers. Fathers bring unique gifts into the home—leadership, protection, wisdom, and stability. When dads are engaged and intentional, children are more likely to thrive emotionally, academically, and socially. In a recent Moms for America Podcast episode, we spoke with EksAyn Anderson, host of The Principle Podcast, founder of Fathers for Freedom, and author of What I Want My Children to Know Before I Die. His message is clear and timely: fathers matter, and their influence extends far beyond the home. Anderson encourages men to embrace their responsibility to lead with purpose, conviction, and love. He describes fathers as the “CEO” of the family—not in power, but in responsibility—setting vision, values, and direction for the next generation. In a culture that often minimizes fatherhood, this conversation is a reminder that dads are essential. Their presence and leadership leave a lasting legacy. Whether you are a father, supporting a father, or invested in the future of our nation, this episode offers encouragement and practical wisdom. Listen in and discover why strengthening fathers strengthens America. Watch or listen now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/bePxGn3Ft/c?w=twYAPbgtX8l3wivGSy_Ec6ND2fIwTJ6_-hMwDUBB_2c.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/bePxGn3Ft/c?w=qcsOfFHKoXGsCoXEdpFiAju4yywJc5e5pKUwIiyUEps.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/bePxGn3Ft/c?w=aSiZnJDB08EDHaYhfrol90r3dIgu2xr0c4t4ZrUjvDI.), or [Apple Podcast](https://momsforamerica.us/so/bePxGn3Ft/c?w=dd8oiEaoKIGptJTXo9ttl2xtUbLCRLCiT7TETsH042w.) — and Happy Father's Day!

clean_body: 8 Reasons We’re Celebrating American Dads | This Father’s Day, we’re honoring the men who help shape families, strengthen communities, and influence the future of our nation. While no dad is perfect, fathers who are present, committed, and growing alongside their families provide s | | Can 't see this message? | | | | | | | June 16, 2026 Newsletter | | 8 Reasons We’re Celebrating American Dads | | | | This Father’s Day, we’re honoring the men who help shape families, strengthen communities, and influence the future of our nation. While no dad is perfect, fathers who are present, committed, and growing alongside their families provide something truly irreplaceable. From protecting and providing to teaching life lessons and creating unforgettable memories, dads play a unique role in the lives of their children. Research consistently shows that involved fathers help foster emotional stability, confidence, academic success, and healthier relationships later in life. Fathers are often the ones teaching practical skills, modeling perseverance, and showing children how to navigate both success and failure. They bring laughter through their legendary dad jokes, courage through their example, and wisdom through years of experience. For sons, dads provide a living model of manhood, responsibility, and integrity. For daughters, they often become the first example of how a woman should be valued and treated. Their influence echoes far beyond childhood. Perhaps most importantly, fathers who live out their faith create a lasting spiritual legacy. Through everyday moments and life's greatest challenges, they demonstrate resilience, hope, and trust in God. And through it all, dads rarely give up. They cheer us on, guide us through mistakes, celebrate our victories, and quietly leave a mark on generations to come. This week, we’re saying thank you to the fathers, husbands, grandfathers, and father figures who make history every day—not from positions of fame, but through the lives they shape at home. Discover the 8 reasons we’re celebrating dads, along with the inspiring story of Theodore Roosevelt’s devotion to fatherhood, in our on the website. | | | | | | The Essential Role of Fathers | | | | At Moms for America, we often highlight the vital role of mothers, but strong families also require strong fathers. Fathers bring unique gifts into the home—leadership, protection, wisdom, and stability. When dads are engaged and intentional, children are more likely to thrive emotionally, academically, and socially. In a recent Moms for America Podcast episode, we spoke with EksAyn Anderson, host of The Principle Podcast, founder of Fathers for Freedom, and author of What I Want My Children to Know Before I Die. His message is clear and timely: fathers matter, and their influence extends far beyond the home. Anderson encourages men to embrace their responsibility to lead with purpose, conviction, and love. He describes fathers as the “CEO” of the family—not in power, but in responsibility—setting vision, values, and direction for the next generation. In a culture that often minimizes fatherhood, this conversation is a reminder that dads are essential. Their presence and leadership leave a lasting legacy. Whether you are a father, supporting a father, or invested in the future of our nation, this episode offers encouragement and practical wisdom. Listen in and discover why strengthening fathers strengthens America. subject: WELCOME to Team Kiggans Campaign Newsletter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
We are officially running under the original district lines - same as our 2024 and 2022 elections!

| | | | | | | [](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
WELCOME to Team Kiggans Campaign Newsletter! We are officially running under the original district lines - same as our 2024 and 2022 elections! After exhausting every avenue to gerrymander our district for political gain, Democrats lost their effort to unconstitutionally redraw our Congressional district lines. Both the Supreme Court of Virginia and the Supreme Court of the United States rejected their gerrymandering push and upheld the rule of law. This was a victory for the Virginia Constitution and for fairness and has kicked our campaign’s momentum into hyper-drive!
---
---

The Last Few Weeks I...
---
Officially became the Republican nominee for my re-election in the Republican primary! This would not have been possible without the help of countless volunteers who helped me collect thousands of signatures to get on the ballot. I am humbled by the support of commonsense voters putting their trust in me again, and I look forward to continuing to represent you and our shared values!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.)
---
Day in Franklin
---
I started my Mother’s Day weekend at the season opening of the ‘Franklin's Market on Main’ in downtown Franklin! I was grateful for the company of local businesses, and my family was grateful for the fresh produce I brought home!

Service Runs in our Family
---
My son Jake was officially winged as a Naval Aviator!!! My husband Steve and I could not be prouder that he’s following in our footsteps of serving our great country and has achieved this magnificent milestone!
---
[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._iT7ghANhXkOuA)
---
More Red White and Blue
---
Talk about a patriotic few weeks! From welcoming home sailors from their record-long deployment on the USS Gerald S Ford Battlegroup, supporting our veterans at the American Legion Auxiliary Unit 110 fundraiser, joining Gold Star families for a Memorial Day Ceremony in Virginia Beach, and being at the amazing Patriotic Festival, it was an honor to spend time being reminded just how blessed we are by the service and sacrifice of our military and veterans.

## **News from the Campaign Trail**
### **Week in Review****:**

Over the last few weeks, Nancy has been visiting with residents across the district and learning more about them, their hopes, concerns and challenges they are currently facing.“I’m grateful for every opportunity to meet with future constituents, and I look forward to a summer filled with events like these. I hope to see you at upcoming events across Lancaster and southern York Counties!” — Nancy

**Mental Health America – Lancaster and Lebanon Counties Legislative Breakfast**
On Thursday, May 28, Nancy attended the Mental Health America Lancaster and Lebanon Counties Legislative Breakfast. As a former emergency nurse, she treated thousands of patients facing mental health challenges. She sees several urgent priorities:
• Expanding early screening and intervention for mental illness;• Ensuring mental health care is reimbursed at the same level as physical health care;• Reducing barriers to outpatient, telehealth, and residential treatment; and• Addressing the connection between mental health and homelessness.
As your Congressperson, Nancy will be committed to supporting patients, families, and communities by expanding access to essential mental health services and programs.

**Breakfast on Hershey Farm**
The Farmland Trust hosted “Breakfast on the Hershey Farm” in Manheim on Saturday, May 30. The event highlighted the history of this preserved farm and the Trust’s work to permanently protect farmland and promote responsible stewardship. Every acre preserved supports today’s farm families while strengthening the local economy and protecting the environment.
Supporting farmers and safeguarding our natural resources are priorities for Nancy, and she will work to ensure prime farmland continues to produce the crops and livestock that sustain our communities and feed the nation.

**African American Cultural Alliance Fair**
The African American Cultural Alliance of Lancaster held its fair and parade at Reservoir Park in Lancaster City last week. The event featured art, music, and food celebrating African American history and culture. Nancy spoke with attendees of all ages and heard why they value life in South Central Pennsylvania. She also listened to their current and future concerns. A common theme she heard: individuals want stability for their families and opportunities to grow—not only financially, but also through education and housing.

Team —
It’s Sherrod Brown. I asked Gabby Giffords if I could share an important update about my Senate race.
**The first public poll of the general election in Ohio was just released, and you need to take a look:**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-brown26.YwpB0k&refcode=em260615-1-b&t=2&akid=11551%2E3935704%2E0Gmpvb)
This is a big deal. It’s the first public poll of the general election — and the data proves Ohio is ready to unseat my opponent, Jon Husted, and pave a path for us to flip the Senate in November.
**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.** [**Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and GIFFORDS PAC so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-brown26.YwpB0k&refcode=em260615-1-b&t=3&akid=11551%2E3935704%2E0Gmpvb)

Folks are fed up with rising costs, rampant corruption, and a rigged system that makes it impossible to get ahead no matter how hard you work. So they’re showing up to make a change and proving that we have the support to flip this seat, even in a state Trump won by 11 points last time.

State Sen. Rick Bennett of Oxford, the former chairman of the Maine GOP who unenrolled from the party prior to his current run for governor as an unenrolled candidate, voted in the 2026 Democratic primary, according to public records reviewed by _The Robinson Report_.
Under Maine law, certain election records are public and obtainable by party officials, including whether a registered voter cast a ballot in a given election.
In this case, records show Bennett pulling a Democratic ballot. As a voter who unenrolled from the Republican Party on June 24, 2025, and is currently unaffiliated with either party, Bennett was free to choose which primary he wanted to vote in.
This Substack is reader-supported. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.

Bennett did not respond to an inquiry Monday about which Democratic candidates he ranked first on his ranked-choice primary ballot.
Word of Bennett's decision quickly spread through the small world of Maine politics.
Presumptive Republican gubernatorial nominee Bobby Charles scorched Bennett in a video posted to social media Tuesday morning.
"Rick Bennett wants Mainers to believe he's an independent," said Charles. "But his record speaks for itself: sanctuary state policies, blocking ICE cooperation, cashless bail, and putting criminals ahead of citizens."
"That's not independent leadership. That's progressive Democrat behavior," said Charles.
[| | | | | Bobby Charles for Maine Governor
---
@Bobby4Maine
Rick Bennett wants Mainers to believe he's an independent. But his record speaks for itself: sanctuary state policies, blocking ICE cooperation, cashless bail, and putting criminals ahead of citizens. That's not independent leadership. That's progressive Democrat behavior.
| 12:43 PM * Jun 16, 2026 * 65 Views4 Reposts * 6 Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/5518c938-f515-4559-a349-2cc84ad6e5fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Robert Wessels, a constituent of Bennett's who ran for governor against Charles in the GOP primary, said the Oxford County senator had "gone off the rails in recent years."
"He is your typical big government politician. He has voted in favor of keeping boys in girls' sports, he voted in favor of creating town-sponsored legal 'safe' places where people could go to do illegal drugs and not get in trouble, and he voted in favor of the state taking the Bangor Mall by eminent domain if necessary -- which didn't end up happening. All of those are enough for me to not consider him," Wessels said.
Bennett's leftward veer is yet another quixotic move by the longtime politician, one that could be interpreted as "maverick"-style thinking or another case of self-interest steering politics.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..7HKu_5DQtLL8Ll_JJlPAqP0EVcyscm8zWRoxk5ebrs0?)
Bennett has been running for political office since 1990, when he lost a bid to replace then-Sen. Olympia Snowe in Maine's 2nd Congressional District to John Baldacci, a centrist Democrat who served in the U.S. House until he won his own gubernatorial election in 2002.
In 2001, Bennett entered into an unusual power-sharing arrangement with another member of the State Senate, Democrat Mike Michaud. With the State Senate evenly divided between parties, they struck an agreement to each serve one year of a two-year legislative session as Senate president. Bennett is widely regarded as having gotten the worse end of the deal, as Michaud was permitted to preside over the first session of the legislative body, during which most important business was conducted.
He was term-limited in 2004 but would find himself again trying to fill Snowe's shoes in 2012, when the longtime Maine senator surprised political observers by declining to run for re-election. He lost the primary, but -- amid the national Tea Party movement and populist opposition to President Barack Obama -- Bennett jumped on the bandwagon in the role of Maine GOP party chair under then-Gov. Paul LePage.
In 2016, Bennett supported President Donald Trump and served as a Republican Party elector.
By 2025, however, with his eyes on a future higher office, Bennett broke with his Republican Party colleagues -- and 60-80 percent of American adults, depending on which poll look at -- to support forcing high school female athletes to compete against males who say they are girls.
Bennett's vote to uphold the unpopular statewide policy coincided with his unenrollment from the Republican Party and decision to run for governor as a so-called "independent."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..jVPUCnRJOtXsVSkL3Wc06mY2aeGAzMe-0xLu46UadUk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=202279230)
Democrats, for their part, aren't convinced of Bennett's newfound maverick streak.
The Maine Democratic Party has released a website -- unimaginatively dubbed "Rick's Receipts" -- that documents Bennett's time as a Republican.
Regardless of which way the wind blows, Bennett's presence on the November ballot will alter the fundamentals of the race. However, unlike the primary elections, the results of which are still being divined one week later, the general election will not use ranked-choice voting.
That means a candidate can win the gubernatorial election with a plurality -- or less than 50 percent of votes -- like former Govs. John Baldacci and Paul LePage did.

Let me tell you about four letters most people in Utah had never heard a year ago: **MIDA**.
By the end of this, you'll understand why people in _every_ state should learn them too. Because what happened here is a blueprint they are trying to replicate all over the country.
MIDA stands for the Military Installation Development Authority. The state created it back in 2007 for one specific job: take old, unused land near military bases and fix it up. It was a narrow and defensible job.
This spring, MIDA approved a **40,000-acre data center and natural gas power plant** in Box Elder County. It's backed by the "Shark Tank" guy, Kevin O'Leary. And it's on private ranchland, not military land.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad44c5af-e5e8-429b-a0c0-6e3595fa7e6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
MIDA was built for a small, specific purpose, and it's being stretched to cover something enormous and completely different.
Picture a soccer match where one team also gets to be the referee. They call their own fouls. They move the goalposts mid-game. Oh, and they wrote the rulebook, and the rule they wrote says nobody else's rules apply to them. In a single agency, it is:
* The **government** that approves the project
* The **tax collector**
* The **regulator** that's supposed to set the rules
* And the **business partner** that profits from the deal

There's no opposing team. There's barely a referee.
And it gets more specific than that. In black-letter Utah law, section 63H-1-202, MIDA and the land inside its projects are **not subject to** :
* The county land-use laws
* The city land-use laws
* Any local ordinance, including ones about **health** , business licensing, even franchises

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..TvIfgcKDF1tosR7-DO2FreCfBnFmPMxiM9KFdfFjmkU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=202224998)
They wrote themselves out of the _health_ rules and the _land-use_ rules that protect you and your neighbors in the actual code.
On top of that, MIDA has statewide reach, it never expires ("perpetual succession" is the legal term), it can act _outside_ its own project areas, it has police power "as though it were a city," and its sub-districts can use eminent domain to take property, and even the **groundwater underneath it**.
It's a city you never voted for with no mayor you can fire that can take your land and your water.
So who is watching them? Every government is supposed to have a watchdog. For most Utah agencies, that's the State Auditor. But here's the trick: **MIDA hires and pays its own private auditor.** The state's independent auditor is locked out.
Picture taking a test where you grade your own paper, you pick the teacher, and you sign her paycheck. Would you trust that grade? That's the oversight MIDA gives itself.
After MIDA approved the O'Leary project, thousands of us did something simple. We wrote letters. We called. We flooded the State Auditor's office demanding answers about what MIDA even _is_. State Auditor Tina Cannon actually listened.
She built a public website with an interactive timeline going back to 2007 with a history of who sits on the board, and a map of every MIDA project across the state. She put hundreds of documents, all in one place where normal people can see them.
And then she did the bravest thing a public official can do. She told the truth about the limits of her own power. Her office, she confirmed, **does not audit MIDA, and has no control over the private firm that does.** Cannon shined a light on it, and she did it because we made noise. _We_ made that happen.
You can see what she built at **[transparent.utah.gov/mida](https://substack.com/redirect/db5c7e2e-c782-460e-bcc3-3b49943ac9b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
On Cannon's site, you'll find MIDA's own brochure. It brags that MIDA has "extreme oversight" and "transparency." On the _same website_ , the auditor's own description says MIDA operates "without any other governmental oversight."
Here's the sentence that should worry every American. MIDA's own plan for this project calls it a **" replicable model."** That's their word. They're advertising it as a blueprint other places can follow.
And the blueprint is simple:
1. **MIDA picks the land** , and designates it a "project area."
2. **The county signs one consent paper.** A Box Elder commissioner called it _irrevocable_. It's one signature, no take-backs.
3. **The environmental review comes after the deal, not before.** You find out what it does to your water and air once it's already approved.

That's how you move a billion-dollar industrial complex past an entire community before they can organize. And it's already spreading. There's a separate project in Millard County, a 12-gigawatt campus on thousands of acres, that broke ground using a _different_ fast-track tool. Utah has built **several** of these vehicles to route giant infrastructure around local democracy.
If they can cram a project this big down our throats here, with this little say from the people who live here, it can happen in your state next. The data-center boom is national. The pressure is coming everywhere. Utah is the test kitchen. It's a system built to skip the public, copied and sold as a model, in the middle of a nationwide rush to build.
But the people who designed this counted on one thing: that you'd never hear those four letters. That it would stay quiet and technical and boring enough that nobody looked.
We blew that up. We turned MIDA into the most-asked-about agency in the state. We pushed the State Auditor to act. We're united, left and right, ranchers and city folks, people who agree on almost nothing else, because this isn't a partisan fight. It's a _who-gets-a-say_ fight.
Go look at the dashboard at transparent.utah.gov/mida. Share this with someone in another state. Call your legislators and ask them one question: _why is MIDA exempt from the laws that protect the rest of us?_
They wrote themselves out of the rulebook. We're going to write them back in.
We will fight to protect Utah, and we'll hand every other state the warning we wish we'd gotten.

Moms.gov is the latest page in the anti-choice playbook |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133431908/627856711/-1080350292?refcode=WUEFER40_20260616_RFKOppo_ALL_v1s4&sourceid=1059140&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMWRjMTgyYi05NDY5LWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uktjp9ldrupQnn1u7rozAqbUBK21zwl_1R1eVhznOks=) Peter, the latest page in Republicans’ anti-choice playbook is truly deplorable.

The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, led by MAGA extremist Robert F. Kennedy, Jr., used Mother’s Day as an excuse to launch a government website called Moms.gov.

RFK Jr. claims it’s a resource to support new and expecting mothers. But instead of giving women and families trustworthy, comprehensive information, Moms.gov directs people to anti-abortion centers that trick women and present themselves as real healthcare clinics, all while pushing their own vehemently anti-abortion political agenda.

That’s not support. It’s deception.

A congressional letter to RFK Jr. about Moms.gov, led by EMILYs List candidate Rep. Emilia Sykes (OH-13), says it best: **_"Moms.gov is duplicitous, a waste of government resources, and a thinly veiled attempt to push a far-right agenda onto people at a vulnerable time in their lives."_**

[**EMILYs List women are running for office all across the country to push back against Republicans’ extreme anti-choice agenda — and they need our support to build winning campaigns. RFK Jr. is all-in on Trump’s agenda of enacting anti-choice policies that harm women and families. He has already said he would implement Trump’s policies on Title X, which would limit healthcare providers’ ability to counsel patients about abortion care. He has also supported restricting access to medication abortion via telehealth, and cutting off federal funding for abortion care.

Right now, he’s helping lead a sham FDA “review” of mifepristone — a medication used in abortion and miscarriage care that has already been FDA-approved and proven safe and effective by decades of scientific research.

**That’s why we’re proud that EMILYs List women like Rep. Emilia Sykes are taking on extreme Republicans like RFK Jr. and their anti-choice agenda. This November, electing Democratic pro-choice women will be key to safeguarding reproductive freedom at every level of government.**

# **FBI foils multi-phase drone and sniper terror plot against UFC White House event**
The FBI thwarted a sophisticated terror plot targeting last Sunday's UFC Freedom 250 event on the White House South Lawn, **[arresting five suspects in a multi-state operation revealed Tuesday.](https://substack.com/redirect/9b5e3c0a-b722-4da0-b024-0ad16ae1a94b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Investigators learned of the plot on June 10 and executed a search warrant in Cincinnati, making the first arrest. Some suspects traveled to Fredericksburg, Virginia in the days before the event to conduct preparations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9b5e3c0a-b722-4da0-b024-0ad16ae1a94b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The planned attack was designed to unfold in coordinated waves.** Explosive-laden drones would first strike nearby buildings, triggering mass panic and driving the crowd toward a waiting sniper team. A second wave of attackers then allegedly planned to storm the White House gate amid the chaos. Investigators found at least 23 individuals discussing the attack's details on encrypted messaging app Signal after examining a suspect's phone.
* **Suspects told investigators the attack was motivated by hostility toward "capitalist elites," billionaires,** and politicians with ties to AIPAC. FBI Director Kash Patel credited swift inter-agency coordination for stopping the plot, calling the outcome the result of routine but exceptional investigative work. The event had drawn approximately 4,300 attendees, including 1,200 active-duty service members.

Peter,
Early this morning, the Department of Homeland Security conducted pre-dawn raids across Minneapolis, Minnesota and arrested 15 people on "conspiracy charges" for daring to protest ICE's occupation of the city earlier this year.
In a media release announcing the charges, DHS accused the protesters of being members of "ANTIFA"--a completely manufactured boogeyman MAGA invented to justify going after its critics, despite the fact that it isn't a real organization.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00103vV_5W-5bopL1OLwTTJbG0vyTwS24Uk_jRyGDcQoi-P65PdWR8Se_t_SsVZ2LV2xC9zKOCys-AMOlQK6EEeLDm1WIdoC6YX8rh0HsK_-6zlmdRU16arXbKJXZRn82dt6vybJNeLuB1DPGpOVHdNhUYTtmv_Ql8thSb4SPMp5aO0dzRYLu6llsy9l39-PtcdF6G9K5o1Ugz72boOfx9YCMK49Yx4icGcATqyf6LUy8w=&c=G6mugA-Oa1MFQxmtbC4CwAZXMpqd_ajLS-KoUUpo7EiNT6ylz2DSsg==&ch=zXCRpGsz2M6zHuPXWlADPwUlRY9qHat7RWKG01Zl7aOT96y7ksc9ww==)

This comes on the heels of FBI raids on a prominent progressive voting rights organization in Ohio.
The Trump administration now has progressive activists in its sights, and is unleashing the full weight of the federal government to try and intimidate Democrats into silence.
None of this is happening by accident. Last fall, Trump signed something called NSPM-7--a presidential memorandum that claims to fight "domestic terrorism" and "political violence." In reality, it redefined opposition to Trump as terrorism. It directs the FBI's Joint Terrorism Task Forces to go after progressive activists, nonprofits, and the people who fund them. It even tasks the IRS with going after the donors behind movements Trump doesn't like.
The directive is explicit about who it's targeting: not violent criminals, but people with "extreme viewpoints on immigration," people who oppose this administration's policies, people who protest. This is a fascist crackdown and an assault on our First Amendment rights.
Democrats must fight back and save our democracy. Defend Our Courts is leading the defense. We are fighting on two fronts. First, building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections state by state. Second, building the movement to reclaim the Supreme Court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
Every day the Trump administration launches a new assault on democracy. We must stop them this November. | | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/elizabethforvirginia/mother-nature-is-always-right?e=2f83c585b2)

| | | | | |
# _Mother Nature Is Always Right_
---
| |
**There are some forces in this world that no amount of money, power, or spectacle can control. One of them is Mother Nature.**
**This week, plans for a UFC fight card on the White House grounds were washed out by storms. There’s real irony here. A made-for-TV display of wealth, celebrity, and political theater, staged on the lawn of the people's house - delayed by a thunderstorm.**
**For all the talk about strength and dominance, it turns out rain clouds don't care about Trump’s birthday. Maybe there's a lesson in that. Because real patriotism has never been about putting on a show. It’s never been about who can throw the biggest party, attract the most attention, or turn public service into entertainment.**
**Real patriotism is being willing to tell the truth about our country, not just the parts that make us proud, but the parts that challenge us. It's celebrating America's achievements while acknowledging the injustices that shaped our history. It's understanding that loving your country means believing it can always become better.**
**Real patriotism isn't found in a spectacle, it's found in neighborhoods. It's helping a neighbor shovel a driveway after a storm. (One that affected them too, regardless of wether or not the White House cared.) It's showing up for a school board meeting. It's volunteering at a food bank. It's standing up for the people in your community when they need support. **
**Patriotism isn't about looking at history through rose-colored glasses, it’s about learning from the past, building for the future, and taking responsibility for the country we share today.**
**That's the kind of patriotism we're building this campaign around. Not performative patriotism, real patriotism. Elizabeth’s kind of patriotism is the kind that puts community before a title and service before spectacle. **
**And today, we're asking for a symbolic contribution to help us continue that work. Donald Trump just turned 80 years old. While others celebrate with lavish parties and photo ops, we're asking supporters to contribute $80 to build something more meaningful: a campaign focused on community, accountability, and a vision of patriotism that includes everyone.**
**Can you chip in $80 today? Every contribution helps us organize, reach voters, and build a movement rooted in the values that real Americans believe in. **
**Because when the stages are packed up and when the storms roll in, those are the values that remain.**
**Thank you for all of your incredible support,****Elizabeth**

| **__A Secure Briefing from the Desk of Jim Jordan__**
---
Friend,
---
I can’t lie to you, I’m deeply worried for our country...
---
**In special election after special election, Obama-funded Democrats have CRUSHED Republicans in voter turnout – and with just over 5 months to go until Election Day, Democrats are _still_ LEADING in all the generic ballot polls! **
---
But we still have time to turn the tide back in our favor.
---
I think in many ways this election is really two sentences: **_They're _crazy_. We're _not_._**
---
_Congressional Democrats have an abysmally low 18% approval rating because they want to open our borders, defund the police, indoctrinate our children, censor our free speech, and shred our constitutional rights._
---
However, that means NOTHING if we can’t motivate Republican voters to show up and cast a ballot when we need them most!
---
**Look – if we’re going to defy history and win the midterm elections, Republicans can’t just say we’re going to stop the Radical Left and call it a day.**
---
Instead, we have to give voters a reason to cast a ballot **_for_** the GOP, not merely **_against_** the Democrats!
---
What we need to do is contrast the Left’s insanity with our own common-sense platform that appeals to the vast majority of Americans, just like President Trump did during his historic victory in 2024.
---
That’s why the President announced that the GOP will be holding an unprecedented midterm convention!
---

[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkE2OnTAQhE9jdg_5BwwsvJgIsZsoiiLNEjV2m-fEP8g2864fEZEDzPar6lJXfbyv7-C8i_t3CKhytWsuazprsvWZzgLRlGTRu91tHj9XTrl8UPlg8vKxxiijDTDdoGLDyCQXo6TNU2mAcdoECNt3FDgXw8AFG63lskcJY-PUFUUlk6wXjNK24wiAvNukNmLqGOkoeMy1zXicm3caYoXyx6assdUpNF49az0KEW-EL4QvBfWZsX25mNFcDsKXihAev1M2EAlfLLXCoAW26WHqJ33dieWsYdUQDnB7JGK-3-oJl5cS0LgzEDFjAOdvWDUR889fy-N_h5uXdGaNl_axfruZTrFirETMP96arMzxct67IgfS0f3K_Femfn36T8X_BgAA__-T0ZAd)

With Republicans trailing in the polls, everything now rests on this historic, first-ever midterm convention. This is our best – _and likely, our final_ – chance to showcase our winning platform and make our case to the American people in front of the entire nation.
---
**But our winning platform can’t be written in Congress, the West Wing, or on Air Force One. Nope! It can ONLY be written directly by salt of the earth grassroots _voters_ like **_YOU._****
---
Out of thousands of eligible voter records, I’ve chosen YOU to represent your zip code as an official **Virtual Grassroots Delegate** for our Midterm Convention based on your exemplary track record of supporting both President Trump and the Republican Party.

name: Jim Jordan
subject: I need you to represent your zip code
body:
Represent your zip code at the GOP’s Midterm Convention

Represent your zip code at the GOP’s Midterm Convention...
| **__A Secure Briefing from the Desk of Jim Jordan__**
---
Friend,
---
I can’t lie to you, I’m deeply worried for our country...
---
**In special election after special election, Obama-funded Democrats have CRUSHED Republicans in voter turnout – and with just over 5 months to go until Election Day, Democrats are _still_ LEADING in all the generic ballot polls! **
---
But we still have time to turn the tide back in our favor.
---
I think in many ways this election is really two sentences: **_They're _crazy_. We're _not_._**
---
_Congressional Democrats have an abysmally low 18% approval rating because they want to open our borders, defund the police, indoctrinate our children, censor our free speech, and shred our constitutional rights._
---
However, that means NOTHING if we can’t motivate Republican voters to show up and cast a ballot when we need them most!
---
**Look – if we’re going to defy history and win the midterm elections, Republicans can’t just say we’re going to stop the Radical Left and call it a day.**
---
Instead, we have to give voters a reason to cast a ballot **_for_** the GOP, not merely **_against_** the Democrats!
---
What we need to do is contrast the Left’s insanity with our own common-sense platform that appeals to the vast majority of Americans, just like President Trump did during his historic victory in 2024.
---
That’s why the President announced that the GOP will be holding an unprecedented midterm convention!
---

[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM2O3CAQhJ8G32zxZxgOHDaxLOWwUZRD9mhhaM8QGbAAezR5-siR8wB7a1VVl_rrj_fp3fjVx_t3E0Dbw0-5TD4CuFfaa8qwZSgQ6yvt-Y-fKKaixaIl4syRxmnrBKMNaCJvRFAub7J5aDUrIu0siAROJVfM3ZTlbGZKzdBb3nh9NmFBBOm5oH0nLTaKL9IZKTGdKeJ435ypUDqbYoF8mOoP8DGmc0qxsyk0q37UuhXE3hAdER0L2D1D9_QxgzsTiI4VTGh_p-xMRHRc8MIcLIbMVqpe2XOPjXsNkzVhM_4eERuu23pExekEcH4PiA0QjF8vsVrEhq-_vtH2P8lllLRnC4gNPz-mL5dmU6wQK2LDj7cma7c9_br6IiTi-H6W_qOpn___oenfAAAA__-Iw5Ih)
---

With Republicans trailing in the polls, everything now rests on this historic, first-ever midterm convention. This is our best – _and likely, our final_ – chance to showcase our winning platform and make our case to the American people in front of the entire nation.
---
**But our winning platform can’t be written in Congress, the West Wing, or on Air Force One. Nope! It can ONLY be written directly by salt of the earth grassroots _voters_ like **_YOU._****
---
Out of thousands of eligible voter records, I’ve chosen YOU to represent your zip code as an official **Virtual Grassroots Delegate** for our Midterm Convention based on your exemplary track record of supporting both President Trump and the Republican Party.
---
_I hope you won’t let me down,Friend._
---
[**Please complete the GOP’s Midterm Convention Platform Survey to represent your zip code as a “Virtual Grassroots Delegate” – and your input will be used to help write our Party’s winning platform at our FIRST-EVER Midterm Convention.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM2O3CAQhJ8G32zxZxgOHDaxLOWwUZRD9mhhaM8QGbAAezR5-siR8wB7a1VVl_rrj_fp3fjVx_t3E0Dbw0-5TD4CuFfaa8qwZSgQ6yvt-Y-fKKaixaIl4syRxmnrBKMNaCJvRFAub7J5aDUrIu0siAROJVfM3ZTlbGZKzdBb3nh9NmFBBOm5oH0nLTaKL9IZKTGdKeJ435ypUDqbYoF8mOoP8DGmc0qxsyk0q37UuhXE3hAdER0L2D1D9_QxgzsTiI4VTGh_p-xMRHRc8MIcLIbMVqpe2XOPjXsNkzVhM_4eERuu23pExekEcH4PiA0QjF8vsVrEhq-_vtH2P8lllLRnC4gNPz-mL5dmU6wQK2LDj7cma7c9_br6IiTi-H6W_qOpn___oenfAAAA__-Iw5Ih)
---

[COMPLETE THE SURVEY ](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkM2O3CAQhJ8G32zxZxgOHDaxLOWwUZRD9mhhaM8QGbAAezR5-siR8wB7a1VVl_rrj_fp3fjVx_t3E0Dbw0-5TD4CuFfaa8qwZSgQ6yvt-Y-fKKaixaIl4syRxmnrBKMNaCJvRFAub7J5aDUrIu0siAROJVfM3ZTlbGZKzdBb3nh9NmFBBOm5oH0nLTaKL9IZKTGdKeJ435ypUDqbYoF8mOoP8DGmc0qxsyk0q37UuhXE3hAdER0L2D1D9_QxgzsTiI4VTGh_p-xMRHRc8MIcLIbMVqpe2XOPjXsNkzVhM_4eERuu23pExekEcH4PiA0QjF8vsVrEhq-_vtH2P8lllLRnC4gNPz-mL5dmU6wQK2LDj7cma7c9_br6IiTi-H6W_qOpn___oenfAAAA__-Iw5Ih)

subject: The legal bills are climbing
body:
[1]LeftNet

Last fall,
Ken Paxton launched a baseless investigation into Powered by People and
threatened to jail me.

But his lawsuit was never really about the law. It was about trying to
scare us out of organizing, out of speaking up, out of doing the work it
takes to build power in Texas.

We’re now back in court making sure that we present the facts and restore
freedom of speech in Texas. Paxton, on the other hand, is getting called
out by judges for what they’ve described as “unprofessional conduct.” I’m
grateful for the progress we’ve made, but must also acknowledge the real
cost to standing up to his abuse of power.

We’ve now spent more than $500,000 in legal fees fighting Paxton’s
frivolous lawsuits.

Every dollar we’re forced to spend fighting him in court is a dollar we
can’t put into the work that actually gets people registered and turned
out to vote.

That’s the point of Paxton's attacks. To drain us, slow us down, and make
the relational organizing work we do that much harder.

We recently exhausted the initial retainer we set aside to defend
ourselves. If we’re going to beat him in court and keep organizing across
Texas, we need your help.

## Is patriotism partisan?
With the official America 250 celebration right around the corner, you'd think the whole country would be coming together to celebrate what makes this nation exceptional.
But the latest polling tells a very different story.
I had Cygnal's Brent Buchanan on the show yesterday, and the numbers he dropped stopped me in my tracks.
American pride headed into Independence Day shouldn't be a partisan issue.
Yet by almost [all the metrics](https://substack.com/redirect/e0392294-daf4-4f55-bb31-003e047a9747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Republicans are consistently proud of their country, while Democrats are overwhelming not.

name: Defenders of Wildlife
subject: America the Beautiful: your action for the future!
body:
Your story can change the world – learn how!

Your story can change the world – learn how!
                  

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5637757/38SyG9Xl)

(https://support.defenders.org/s/5637758/38SyG9Xl)

Defender,

Do you know that your love for wildlife can inspire real change in the world?

It’s true: Each of us discovers our love for nature in our own way, from the gardens in our grandparents’ back yards to the inspirational sights of bison and other animals in places like Yellowstone National Park.

It’s an incredible privilege to enjoy our country’s natural heritage. But as our landscapes and animals come under threat, more and more people like you are taking action to ensure this inheritance isn’t taken away from future generations.

Now you can join in the movement to protect our wilds by using your voice – and your platform – to spread the word! Defenders is partnering with GoFundMe to provide wildlife advocates like you with the tools to become a leader for wildlife in your own community.

Learn how you can create a fundraiser to rally your family and friends to support life-saving work on behalf of wildlife! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5637759/38SyG9Xl)

At Defenders, we know how important it is speak up for wildlife. Whether it’s protecting imperiled species, defending habitat or advocating for stronger conservation policies, every day we show up because we care deeply about wildlife and the future of our planet.

We know you care too, and that’s why we want to further empower you to protect what matters most. Through community fundraising, and backed by the power of GoFundMe, you can share your connection to nature, inspire others and help defend animals and habitats for the next 250 years.

Getting started is easy, and by creating your own campaign for wildlife you can enlist your friends, family and other members of the community to protect animals against the threat of extinction!

Your story can change the world for the better: See how by starting your own community fundraiser to protect and restore wildlife and wild places! (https://support.defenders.org/s/5637760/38SyG9Xl)

Defender, we’re proud to partner with you to save our planet and keep America wild (https://support.defenders.org/s/5637761/38SyG9Xl) for the next generation. Thank you for all you do.

Sincerely,

Defenders of Wildlife

P.S.: Through our partnership with GoFundMe, community fundraising is easy. Let your friends and family know that they can raise their voice for wildlife with GoFundMe (https://support.defenders.org/s/5637762/38SyG9Xl) as well!

(http://www.facebook.com/DefendersofWildlife) (http://twitter.com/defenders) (https://www.instagram.com/defendersofwildlife/?hl=en) (http://www.youtube.com/defendersofwildlife) (https://www.tiktok.com/@defendersofwildlife)

Defenders of Wildlife 1130 17th Street NW • Washington, DC 20036 defenders.org (https://defenders.org)
